_**Agent (claude-opus-5-5 2026-10-05 17:35:47Z)**_

The problem is on [Overview.tsx:871](packages/desktop-client/src/components/reports/Overview.tsx#L871): there's no space after the `:` in the ternary chain.

```tsx
) :widget.type === 'budget-analysis-card' &&
```

Every other branch in that chain is written `) : widget.type === ...` (see line 862 and line 881). The formatter (oxfmt, which works like Prettier) always puts spaces around the `?` and `:` in a ternary, so it flags this line.

It probably happened when the `goal-card` branch was inserted above it and the space got lost at the join.

To fix it, add the space:

```tsx
) : widget.type === 'budget-analysis-card' &&
```

You can also run `yarn lint:fix` from the repo root, which will fix it automatically. I haven't changed the file; I can make the edit if you want.

```text
1	// Minimal connection mock used by desktop-client component tests.
2	//
3	// This mirrors `@actual-app/core`'s test-only mock implementation so that
4	// `useSpreadsheet()` and other code paths can call `send()` and receive a
5	// promise with a stable shape.
6
7	type Listener = (args: unknown) => void;
8	type Handler = (args: unknown) => unknown | Promise<unknown>;
9
10	let listeners = new Map<string, Array<Listener>>();
11	let serverHandler:
12	  | null
13	  | ((msg: { name: string; args: unknown; catchErrors: boolean }) => unknown) =
14	  null;
15
16	export const initServer = (handlers: Record<string, Handler>) => {
17	  serverHandler = msg => {
18	    const { name, args, catchErrors } = msg;
19	    if (handlers[name]) {
20	      return Promise.resolve().then(() => {
21	        const promise = Promise.resolve(handlers[name](args));
22
23	        if (catchErrors) {
24	          return promise.then(
25	            data => ({ data }),
26	            error => ({ error }),
27	          );
28	        }
29
30	        return promise;
31	      });
32	    }
33	  };
34	};
35
36	export const clearServer = async () => {
37	  serverHandler = null;
38	  listeners = new Map();
39	};
40
41	export const serverPush = (name: string, args: unknown) => {
42	  void Promise.resolve().then(() => {
43	    const listens = listeners.get(name);
44	    if (listens) {
45	      listens.forEach(listener => {
46	        listener(args);
47	      });
48	    }
49	  });
50	};
51
52	export const send = async (
53	  name: string,
54	  args: unknown,
55	  { catchErrors = false } = {},
56	) => {
57	  if (serverHandler) {
58	    return serverHandler({ name, args, catchErrors });
59	  } else {
60	    throw new Error('`send` called with no mock server installed');
61	  }
62	};
63
64	export const sendCatch = (name: string, args: unknown) => {
65	  return send(name, args, { catchErrors: true });
66	};
67
68	export const listen = (name: string, cb: Listener) => {
69	  if (!listeners.get(name)) {
70	    listeners.set(name, []);
71	  }
72
73	  listeners.get(name)!.push(cb);
74
75	  return () => {
76	    const arr = listeners.get(name) ?? [];
77	    listeners.set(
78	      name,
79	      arr.filter(cb_ => cb_ !== cb),
80	    );
81	  };
82	};
83
```

```text
24	    return d.format(dateParsed, 'yyyy-MM-dd');
25	  } else {
26	    return null;
27	  }

30	export function DateRange({
31	  start,
32	  end,
33	  type,
34	  comparisonLabel,
35	}: DateRangeProps): ReactElement {
36	  const { t } = useTranslation();
37	  const locale = useLocale();
38	  const checkStart = checkDate(start);
39	  const checkEnd = checkDate(end);
40
41	  let startDate;
42	  let endDate;
43	  if (checkStart && checkEnd) {
44	    startDate = d.parseISO(checkStart);
45	    endDate = d.parseISO(checkEnd);
46	  } else {
47	    return (
48	      <Text style={{ ...styles.mediumText, color: theme.errorText }}>
49	        <Trans>There was a problem loading your date range</Trans>
50	      </Text>
51	    );
52	  }
53
54	  const formattedStartDate = d.format(startDate, 'MMM yyyy', { locale });
55	  const formattedEndDate = d.format(endDate, 'MMM yyyy', { locale });
56	  let typeOrFormattedEndDate: string;
57
58	  if (type && ['budget', 'average'].includes(type)) {
59	    typeOrFormattedEndDate =
60	      comparisonLabel ?? (type === 'budget' ? t('budgeted') : t('average'));
61	  } else {
62	    typeOrFormattedEndDate = formattedEndDate;
63	  }
64
65	  let content: string | ReactElement;
66	  if (['budget', 'average'].includes(type || '')) {
67	    content = (
68	      <div>
69	        <Trans>
70	          Compare {{ formattedStartDate }} to {{ typeOrFormattedEndDate }}
71	        </Trans>
72	      </div>
73	    );
74	  } else if (
75	    startDate.getFullYear() !== endDate.getFullYear() ||
76	    startDate.getMonth() !== endDate.getMonth()
77	  ) {

83	          </Trans>

86	            {formattedStartDate} - {formattedEndDate}
87	          </>
```

```text
1	import { useCallback, useMemo, useState } from 'react';

3	import type { RuleConditionEntity } from '@actual-app/core/types/models';
4
5	export function useRuleConditionFilters<T extends RuleConditionEntity>(
6	  initialConditions: T[] = [],
7	  initialConditionsOp: 'and' | 'or' = 'and',
8	) {
9	  const [conditions, setConditions] = useState<T[]>(initialConditions);
10	  const [conditionsOp, setConditionsOp] = useState<'and' | 'or'>(
11	    initialConditionsOp,
12	  );
13	  const [saved, setSaved] = useState<T[] | null>(null);
14
15	  const onApply = useCallback(
16	    (
17	      conditionsOrSavedFilter:
18	        | null
19	        | { conditions: T[]; conditionsOp: 'and' | 'or'; id: T[] | null }
20	        | T,
21	    ) => {
22	      if (conditionsOrSavedFilter === null) {
23	        setConditions([]);
24	        setSaved(null);
25	      } else if ('conditions' in conditionsOrSavedFilter) {
26	        setConditions([...conditionsOrSavedFilter.conditions]);
27	        setConditionsOp(conditionsOrSavedFilter.conditionsOp);
28	        setSaved(conditionsOrSavedFilter.id);
29	      } else {
30	        setConditions(state => [...state, conditionsOrSavedFilter]);
31	        setSaved(null);
32	      }
33	    },
34	    [setConditions],
35	  );
36
37	  const onUpdate = useCallback(
38	    (oldFilter: T, updatedFilter: T) => {
39	      setConditions(state =>
40	        state.map(f => (f === oldFilter ? updatedFilter : f)),
41	      );
42	      setSaved(null);
43	    },
44	    [setConditions],
45	  );
46
47	  const onDelete = useCallback(
48	    (deletedFilter: T) => {
49	      setConditions(state => state.filter(f => f !== deletedFilter));
50	      setSaved(null);
51	    },
52	    [setConditions],
53	  );
54
55	  return useMemo(
56	    () => ({
57	      conditions,
58	      saved,
59	      conditionsOp,
60	      onApply,
61	      onUpdate,
62	      onDelete,
63	      onConditionsOpChange: setConditionsOp,
64	    }),
```

```typescript
import React from 'react';

  end: string;

  earliestTransaction: string;
  latestTransaction: string;
  onChangeDates: (start: string, end: string, mode: TimeFrame['mode']) => void;
  onApply: (condition: RuleConditionEntity) => void;
  children?: ReactNode;
};

  Header: ({
    start,
    end,
    mode,
    allMonths,
    earliestTransaction,
    latestTransaction,
    onChangeDates,
    onApply,
    children,
  }: HeaderStubProps) => (
    <div>
      <span data-testid="header-range">{`${start} ${end} ${mode}`}</span>
      <span data-testid="header-bounds">
        {`${earliestTransaction} ${latestTransaction}`}
      </span>
      <span data-testid="header-months">
        {allMonths.map(month => month.name).join(' ')}

      <button
        onClick={() => onChangeDates('2025-01-01', '2025-03-31', 'static')}
      >
        Change dates
      </button>
      <button onClick={() => onApply(TEST_CONDITION)}>Add filter</button>
      {children}
    </div>
  ),
}));

const WIDGET_ID = 'goal-widget-1';
const TAGS: TagEntity[] = [
  { id: 'tag-1', tag: 'vacation' },
  { id: 'tag-2', tag: 'emergency' },
];
const TEST_CONDITION: RuleConditionEntity = {
  field: 'notes',
  op: 'contains',
  value: 'trip',
  type: 'string',
};
const STATIC_TIME_FRAME: TimeFrame = {
  start: '2024-01-01',
  end: '2024-06-30',
  mode: 'static',
};

type Meta = GoalCardWidget['meta'];

function makeWidget(meta: Meta): GoalCardWidget {
  return {
    id: WIDGET_ID,
    dashboard_page_id: 'page-1',
    type: 'goal-card',
    x: 0,
    y: 0,
    width: 4,
    height: 2,
    meta,
    tombstone: false,
  };
}

type ServerOptions = {
  widgets?: GoalCardWidget[];
  earliest?: { date: string } | null;
  latest?: { date: string } | null;
  isWidgetQueryPending?: boolean;
};

function setUpServer({
  widgets = [],
  earliest = { date: '2024-01-05' },
  latest = { date: '2024-06-20' },
  isWidgetQueryPending = false,
}: ServerOptions = {}) {
  const updateWidget = vi.fn((_widget: unknown) => undefined);
  initServer({
    query: () =>
      isWidgetQueryPending
        ? new Promise(() => {})
        : Promise.resolve({ data: widgets }),
    'tags-get': () => TAGS,
    'get-earliest-transaction': () => earliest,
    'get-latest-transaction': () => latest,
    'dashboard-update-widget': updateWidget,
  });
  return { updateWidget };
}

function renderGoalReport({
  meta,
  path = `/reports/goal/${WIDGET_ID}`,
  ...serverOptions
}: { meta?: Meta; path?: string } & ServerOptions = {}) {
  const server = setUpServer({
    widgets: meta === undefined ? [] : [makeWidget(meta)],
    ...serverOptions,
  });
  const queryClient = createTestQueryClient();
  const store = configureTestAppStore({ queryClient });

  render(
    <TestProviders queryClient={queryClient} store={store}>
      <MemoryRouter initialEntries={[path]}>
        <Routes>
          <Route path="/reports/goal" element={<GoalReport />} />
          <Route path="/reports/goal/:id" element={<GoalReport />} />
        </Routes>
      </MemoryRouter>
    </TestProviders>,
  );

  return { ...server, store };
}

async function waitForReport() {
  return screen.findByText('Matching transactions');
}

function getProgressFill() {
  const track = document.querySelector('[aria-hidden="true"]');
  const fill = track?.firstElementChild;
  if (!(fill instanceof HTMLElement)) {
    throw new Error('Progress bar not found');
  }
  return fill;
}

/**
 * Opens the "Linked tag" dropdown and picks the option with the given label.
 */
async function chooseTag(
  user: ReturnType<typeof userEvent.setup>,
  label: string,
) {
  await user.click(screen.getByLabelText('Linked tag'));
  const menu = await screen.findByRole('menu');
  await user.click(within(menu).getByText(label));
}
```

I added [GoalReport.test.tsx](packages/desktop-client/src/components/reports/reports/GoalReport.test.tsx) with 25 tests, and all of them pass. The file also passes oxlint and oxfmt. The full `yarn typecheck` is still running in the background, so type errors aren't ruled out yet. My first version had four type errors in the fake server handlers; I've fixed those, and I'll report what the recheck says when it finishes.

**What the tests cover:**

- **Loading:** the report doesn't show while the widget is still being fetched.
- **Title:** shows the saved name or falls back to "Personal goal". Renaming through the pencil button saves the new name and keeps the other settings. Clearing the name saves "Personal goal".
- **No widget:** the title can't be edited and there's no "Save widget" button.
- **Mobile layout:** the goal name appears in the mobile header, and the back button goes to `/reports`.
- **Amounts and progress:** current and goal amounts display. The percentage is right for partial, over-the-goal (capped at 100%), negative (floored at 0%), and no-goal (no divide by zero) cases. A widget with no saved settings shows as an empty goal. Editing "Goal amount" updates the bar right away.
- **Linked tag:** the description names the linked tag, prompts you to link one when none is set, and updates when you pick a tag.
- **Dates:** the earliest and latest transaction dates are loaded, the month list runs from the earliest transaction to now, and there are 13 months when there are no transactions. The page starts from the saved time frame and updates when dates change.
- **Save widget:** saves the goal amount, tag, filters and time frame, and shows the success notification. Choosing "No tag" removes the linked tag from what's saved.

**How it's set up:** the tests use the real data-loading and save hooks, and the existing fake server in `#mocks/connection` answers their requests. The report's date and filter header is replaced with a stand-in so tests can see what's passed to it and trigger date and filter changes. The real header pulls in date pickers and filter menus that are tested elsewhere.

**Two things to know:**

- **Untested code:** `notifyMissingWidget` (the "Cannot save: No widget available." message) can't be reached from the page. Without a widget, the save button and the editable title are both hidden. You could remove it, or keep it as a safeguard and accept that it's untested.
- **No coverage numbers:** I couldn't measure coverage because `@vitest/coverage-v8` isn't installed. If you want numbers, add it as a dev dependency and run vitest with `--coverage`.

_**Agent (claude-opus-5-5 2026-10-05 23:07:33Z)**_

## Why `notifyMissingWidget` can't be tested

**What it does.** [GoalReport.tsx:156-165](packages/desktop-client/src/components/reports/reports/GoalReport.tsx#L156-L165) shows a red "Cannot save: No widget available." message. Only two places call it, both at the top of a save handler:

- `onSaveWidgetName`, line 168: `if (!widget) { notifyMissingWidget(); return; }`
- `onSaveWidget`, line 186: the same check.

**Why the page never reaches it.** Each handler is attached to a control that only exists when there is a widget:

| Handler            | Control that calls it                     | When that control appears                                                                                                                             |
| ------------------ | ----------------------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `onSaveWidgetName` | `EditablePageHeaderTitle` (pencil button) | Only when `widget` is set ([line 244](packages/desktop-client/src/components/reports/reports/GoalReport.tsx#L244)); otherwise the title is plain text |
| `onSaveWidget`     | "Save widget" button                      | Only when `widget` is set (`{widget && ...}`, [line 275](packages/desktop-client/src/components/reports/reports/GoalReport.tsx#L275))                 |

So by the time someone can click either control, `widget` is already defined and `if (!widget)` is always false.

The one edge case is the widget being deleted while the page is open, for example from another synced device. When the data refreshes, `widget` becomes `undefined` and React re-renders straight away, which removes the button and the pencil in the same render. There's no moment when the button is still visible but `widget` is gone. A test would have to mock `GoalReport`'s own children to force the call, which only shows that the mock works.

**Why you can't simply delete the check.** `widget` is typed `GoalCardWidget | undefined`, and the handlers read `widget.id` and `widget.meta`. Without `if (!widget)`, TypeScript reports "possibly undefined". So some check has to stay. The only question is what it does when it fails.

## How the other reports do it

- **[Summary.tsx](packages/desktop-client/src/components/reports/reports/Summary.tsx#L236) and [Formula.tsx](packages/desktop-client/src/components/reports/reports/Formula.tsx):** the same notification your code uses. You copied a pattern that's already in the codebase.
- **[NetWorth.tsx:225](packages/desktop-client/src/components/reports/reports/NetWorth.tsx#L225):** `throw new Error('No widget that could be saved.')`. This treats the case as a programming error that should never happen.

## Your options

1. **Keep it as is (my recommendation).** It's a harmless safeguard that matches Summary and Formula, and it would do the right thing if someone later shows the save button without a widget. Accept that about 10 lines stay uncovered. If anyone asks about the gap, it's a defensive check that can't be reached through the UI.
2. **Switch to NetWorth's `throw` style.** That's two short lines instead of a helper plus two calls, which shrinks the uncovered code. It's still untested, though, and a user would see a crash instead of a message if the case ever happened.
3. **Remove the message but keep a bare check** (`if (!widget) return;`). That's the smallest amount of code, but the save would fail silently if the case ever happened. I'd avoid this one.

If your course or team has a coverage target and this file is borderline, option 2 is a reasonable trade-off. Otherwise I'd leave the code as it is.

_**Agent (claude-opus-5-5 2026-10-05 23:20:49Z)**_

Your GoalReport changes didn't cause this. It's a Windows-only problem in an existing loot-core test, [main.test.ts](packages/loot-core/src/server/main.test.ts). It fails on every run here, even when the folder doesn't exist before the run starts.

**What happens:**

1. A test in the `Budgets` group creates `mocks/files/budgets/test-budget/` and opens its `db.sqlite` database.
2. After the test, the group's cleanup hook ([line 54-64](packages/loot-core/src/server/main.test.ts#L54-L64)) tries to delete that folder. In Vitest, a group's cleanup runs **before** the file-level cleanup ([line 30-35](packages/loot-core/src/server/main.test.ts#L30-L35)), and the file-level cleanup is the one that closes the budget. So the folder is deleted while the database file is still open.
3. Linux and macOS let you delete an open file, which is why this passes in CI. Windows locks it, so the delete fails with `EBUSY: resource busy or locked, unlink ...db.sqlite`.
4. The folder is left behind, so the next test's `mkdir` fails with the `EEXIST` error you saw. A later test then cleans it up, which is why the failure count varies between runs.

The run I did from a clean state shows both errors:

```
× budget is successfully loaded        → EBUSY ... unlink db.sqlite
× budget detects out of sync migrations → EEXIST ... mkdir test-budget
```

I deleted the leftover `test-budget` folder. It's ignored by git, so this doesn't change anything tracked. The test will still fail on your machine until its cleanup closes the database before deleting the folder.

**Likely fix (not applied or tested):** close the database first in that group's cleanup hook:

```ts
afterEach(async () => {
  await runHandler(handlers['close-budget']);
  await db.closeDatabase();
  fs._setDocumentDir(null);
  const budgetPath = fs.join(__dirname, '/../mocks/files/budgets/test-budget');
  if (await fs.exists(budgetPath)) {
    await fs.removeDirRecursively(budgetPath);
  }
});
```

The extra `db.closeDatabase()` covers the out-of-sync-migrations test, where loading fails but the test had already opened the database directly. I haven't checked whether `db.closeDatabase()` is safe to call when no database is open. Before relying on this, run `yarn workspace @actual-app/core exec vitest --run src/server/main.test.ts` and confirm it passes twice in a row.

**How to proceed:**

- **For your branch:** you can ignore this failure, since it has nothing to do with GoalReport. CI runs on Linux, where it passes.
- **To fix it:** I'd do it on its own branch or PR rather than mixing it into the GoalCard work, since it's an existing upstream issue. I can try the fix and confirm it passes if you want.

---

```markdown
# Plan: Add a GoalReport page and connect the GoalCard widget to it

## Context

The `goal-card` dashboard widget ([GoalCard.tsx](packages/desktop-client/src/components/reports/reports/GoalCard.tsx)) is only a scaffold. Unlike the other widgets, its `ReportCard` has no `to` prop, so clicking it goes nowhere. Every other widget opens a full report page at `/reports/<name>` and `/reports/<name>/:id`, where `:id` is the widget id. We need a minimal `GoalReport` page and its routes so the Goal widget follows the same pattern. Real goal logic (conditions, time frame, calculations) comes later.

## Changes

### 1. New file: `packages/desktop-client/src/components/reports/reports/GoalReport.tsx`

Base it on [Formula.tsx](packages/desktop-client/src/components/reports/reports/Formula.tsx), keeping only the shared parts, and use the loading check from [AgeOfMoney.tsx:51-63](packages/desktop-client/src/components/reports/reports/AgeOfMoney.tsx#L51-L63):

- **`export function GoalReport()`** (outer component):
  - Read `id` with `useParams()`.
  - Call `useDashboardWidget<GoalCardWidget>({ id: params.id, type: 'goal-card' })`.
  - While `isLoading` is true, return `<LoadingIndicator />`.
  - Otherwise render `<GoalReportInner widget={widget} />`.
  - Use `isLoading`, not `isPending`. The query is disabled when there is no `:id`, and a disabled query stays pending forever, so `/reports/goal` would never stop loading.
- **`function GoalReportInner({ widget }: { widget?: GoalCardWidget })`**:
  - Title is `widget?.meta?.name || t('Personal goal')`, the same default as the card.
  - Header follows the Formula pattern:
    - On narrow screens: `MobilePageHeader` with `MobileBackButton` → `navigate('/reports')`.
    - On wide screens: `PageHeader` whose title is an `EditablePageHeaderTitle` when a widget exists.
  - `onSaveWidgetName` uses `useUpdateDashboardWidgetMutation()` and keeps the rest of `widget.meta`. If no widget exists, it shows the same "Cannot save: No widget available." error notification.
  - The body is a simple read-only summary. It shows `currentAmount`, `of targetAmount`, a progress bar and a percent, using the same progress math and styles as GoalCard:
    - `FinancialText`, `PrivacyFilter` and `useFormat`
    - `theme.pillBackground` and `theme.reportsGreen`
    - `styles.tnum` on the percent
  - No "Save widget" button and no editing controls yet. With only a rename, there is nothing else to save.
- All user-facing text uses `Trans`/`t()`. The file is strict TypeScript, with no `@ts-strict-ignore`.

### 2. [ReportRouter.tsx](packages/desktop-client/src/components/reports/ReportRouter.tsx)

- `import { GoalReport } from './reports/GoalReport';`
- Add two routes, `/goal` and `/goal/:id`, each wrapping `<GoalReport />` in `<ReportBoundary>`, using the same structure as the `/summary` routes. They are not behind a feature flag, because the goal card isn't either.

### 3. [GoalCard.tsx](packages/desktop-client/src/components/reports/reports/GoalCard.tsx)

- Add `to={`/reports/goal/${widgetId}`}` to `<ReportCard>`, the same way [SummaryCard.tsx:95](packages/desktop-client/src/components/reports/reports/SummaryCard.tsx#L95) does.

## Reused pieces

- `useDashboardWidget` (`#hooks/useDashboardWidget`)
- `useUpdateDashboardWidgetMutation` (`#reports/mutations`)
- `Page`, `PageHeader`, `MobilePageHeader` (`#components/Page`)
- `EditablePageHeaderTitle`, `MobileBackButton`
- `LoadingIndicator`
- `useNavigate`, `useResponsive`
- `addNotification` and `useDispatch`

  3. Go directly to `/reports/goal`. The page should render the default title, not spin forever.
  4. Check the narrow (mobile) width: the back button should return to `/reports`.
```

```typescript
import { Trans, useTranslation } from 'react-i18next';
import { useParams } from 'react-router';

import { Block } from '@actual-app/components/block';
import { useResponsive } from '@actual-app/components/hooks/useResponsive';
import { styles } from '@actual-app/components/styles';
import { theme } from '@actual-app/components/theme';
import { View } from '@actual-app/components/view';
import type { GoalCardWidget } from '@actual-app/core/types/models';
import type { TransObjectLiteral } from '@actual-app/core/types/util';

import { EditablePageHeaderTitle } from '#components/EditablePageHeaderTitle';
import { FinancialText } from '#components/FinancialText';
import { MobileBackButton } from '#components/mobile/MobileBackButton';
import { MobilePageHeader, Page, PageHeader } from '#components/Page';
import { PrivacyFilter } from '#components/PrivacyFilter';
import { LoadingIndicator } from '#components/reports/LoadingIndicator';
import { useDashboardWidget } from '#hooks/useDashboardWidget';
import { useFormat } from '#hooks/useFormat';
import { useNavigate } from '#hooks/useNavigate';
import { addNotification } from '#notifications/notificationsSlice';
import { useDispatch } from '#redux';
import { useUpdateDashboardWidgetMutation } from '#reports/mutations';

export function GoalReport() {
  const params = useParams();
  const { data: widget, isLoading } = useDashboardWidget<GoalCardWidget>({
    id: params.id,
    type: 'goal-card',
  });

  if (isLoading) {
    return <LoadingIndicator />;
  }

  return <GoalReportInner widget={widget} />;
}

type GoalReportInnerProps = {
  widget?: GoalCardWidget;
};

function GoalReportInner({ widget }: GoalReportInnerProps) {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const dispatch = useDispatch();
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const format = useFormat();
  const { isNarrowWidth } = useResponsive();

  const title = widget?.meta?.name || t('Personal goal');

  const currentAmount = widget?.meta?.currentAmount ?? 0;
  const targetAmount = widget?.meta?.targetAmount ?? 0;
  const progress =
    targetAmount > 0
      ? Math.min(Math.max(currentAmount / targetAmount, 0), 1)
      : 0;
  const progressPercent = Math.round(progress * 100);

  const updateDashboardWidgetMutation = useUpdateDashboardWidgetMutation();

  const onSaveWidgetName = async (newName: string) => {
    if (!widget) {
      dispatch(
        addNotification({
          notification: {
            type: 'error',
            message: t('Cannot save: No widget available.'),
          },
        }),
      );
      return;
    }

    const name = newName || t('Personal goal');
    updateDashboardWidgetMutation.mutate({
      widget: {
        id: widget.id,
        meta: {
          ...(widget.meta ?? {}),
          name,
        },
      },
    });
  };

  return (
    <Page
      header={
        isNarrowWidth ? (
          <MobilePageHeader
            title={title}
            leftContent={
              <MobileBackButton onPress={() => navigate('/reports')} />
            }
          />
        ) : (
          <PageHeader
            title={
              widget ? (
                <EditablePageHeaderTitle
                  title={title}
                  onSave={onSaveWidgetName}
                />
              ) : (
                title
              )
            }
          />
        )
      }
      padding={0}
    >
      <View
        style={{
          flex: 1,
          padding: 20,
          background: theme.pageBackground,
        }}
      >
        <View style={{ marginBottom: 20 }}>
          <Block
            style={{
              ...styles.largeText,
              fontWeight: 500,
              marginBottom: 5,
            }}
          >
            <PrivacyFilter>
              <FinancialText>{format(currentAmount, 'financial')}</FinancialText>
            </PrivacyFilter>
          </Block>
          <Block style={{ color: theme.pageTextSubdued }}>
            <PrivacyFilter>
              <Trans>
                of{' '}
                <FinancialText>
                  {
                    {
                      targetAmount: format(targetAmount, 'financial'),
                    } as TransObjectLiteral
                  }
                </FinancialText>
              </Trans>
            </PrivacyFilter>
          </Block>
        </View>

        <View
          aria-hidden
          style={{
            height: 16,
            borderRadius: 8,
            backgroundColor: theme.pillBackground,
            overflow: 'hidden',
          }}
        >
          <View
            style={{
              width: `${progressPercent}%`,
              height: '100%',
              backgroundColor: theme.reportsGreen,
            }}
          />
        </View>
        <Block
          style={{
            ...styles.tnum,
            marginTop: 5,
            textAlign: 'right',
            color: theme.pageTextSubdued,
          }}
        >
          {progressPercent}%
        </Block>
      </View>
    </Page>
  );
}

```

```text
34
35	export function ReportCard({
36	  widgetId,
37	  isEditing,
38	  disableClick,
39	  to,
40	  children,
41	  size = 1,
42	  style,
43	  onRename,
44	  contextMenuTriggerRef,
45	}: ReportCardProps) {
46	  const ref = useRef(null);
47	  const isInViewport = useIsInViewport(ref);
48	  const [hasRendered, setHasRendered] = useState(false);
49	  const navigate = useNavigate();
50	  const { isNarrowWidth } = useResponsive();
51	  const containerProps = {
52	    flex: isNarrowWidth ? '1 1' : `0 0 calc(${size * 100}% / 3 - 20px)`,
53	  };
54
55	  useEffect(() => {
56	    if (isInViewport && !hasRendered) {
57	      setHasRendered(true);
58	    }
59	  }, [isInViewport, hasRendered]);
60
61	  const layoutProps = {
62	    isEditing,
63	    widgetId,
64	    onRename,
65	    contextMenuTriggerRef,
66	  };
67
68	  const content = (
69	    <View
70	      ref={ref}
71	      style={{
72	        backgroundColor: theme.tableBackground,
73	        borderBottomLeftRadius: 2,
74	        borderBottomRightRadius: 2,
75	        width: '100%',
76	        height: '100%',
77	        boxShadow: '0 2px 6px rgba(0, 0, 0, .15)',
78	        transition: 'box-shadow .25s',
79	        ...(isEditing
80	          ? {
81	              '& .recharts-surface:hover': {
82	                cursor: 'move',
83	                ':active': { cursor: 'grabbing' },
84	              },
85	              ':active': { cursor: 'grabbing' },
86	              filter: 'grayscale(1)',
87	            }
88	          : {
89	              '& .recharts-surface:hover': {
90	                cursor: 'pointer',
91	              },
92	            }),
93	        ':hover': {
94	          ...(to ? { boxShadow: '0 4px 6px rgba(0, 0, 0, .15)' } : null),
95	          ...(isEditing ? { cursor: 'move', filter: 'grayscale(0)' } : null),
96	        },
97	        ...(to ? null : containerProps),
98	        ...style,
99	      }}
100	    >
101	      {/* we render the content only if it is in the viewport
102	      this reduces the amount of concurrent server api calls and thus
103	      has a better performance */}
104	      {isInViewport || hasRendered ? children : null}
105	    </View>
106	  );
107
108	  if (to && !isEditing && !disableClick) {
109	    return (
110	      <Layout {...layoutProps}>
111	        <Button
112	          variant="bare"
113	          onPress={() => navigate(to, { state: { goBack: true } })}
114	          style={{
115	            height: '100%',
116	            width: '100%',
117	            background: 'transparent',
118	            padding: 0,
119	            textAlign: 'left',
120	            overflow: 'visible',
121	          }}
122	        >
123	          {content}
124	        </Button>
125	      </Layout>
126	    );
127	  }
128
129	  return <Layout {...layoutProps}>{content}</Layout>;
130	}
131
132	type LayoutProps = {
133	  children: ReactNode;
134	} & Pick<
135	  ReportCardProps,
136	  'isEditing' | 'widgetId' | 'onRename' | 'contextMenuTriggerRef'
137	>;
138
139	function Layout({
140	  children,
141	  isEditing,
142	  widgetId,
143	  onRename,
144	  contextMenuTriggerRef,
145	}: LayoutProps) {
146	  const { t } = useTranslation();
147	  const dispatch = useDispatch();
148
149	  const triggerRef = useRef<HTMLButtonElement>(null);
150	  const internalViewRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
151	  const viewRef = contextMenuTriggerRef || internalViewRef;
152
153	  const removeDashboardWidgetMutation = useRemoveDashboardWidgetMutation();
154	  const copyDashboardWidgetMutation = useCopyDashboardWidgetMutation();
155
156	  useContextMenu({
157	    triggerRef: viewRef,
158	    items: [
159	      onRename && {
160	        name: 'rename',
161	        text: t('Rename'),
162	        onClick: onRename,
163	        order: 1,
164	      },
165	      {
166	        name: 'remove',
167	        text: t('Remove'),
168	        onClick: () => removeDashboardWidgetMutation.mutate({ id: widgetId }),
169	        order: 1,
170	      },
171	      {
172	        name: 'copy',
173	        text: t('Copy to dashboard'),
174	        onClick: () => {
175	          dispatch(
176	            pushModal({
177	              modal: {
178	                name: 'copy-widget-to-dashboard',
179	                options: {
180	                  onSelect: targetDashboardId => {
181	                    copyDashboardWidgetMutation.mutate({

183	                      targetDashboardPageId: targetDashboardId,
184	                    });
185	                  },
186	                },
187	              },
188	            }),
189	          );
190	        },
191	        order: 1,
192	      },
193	    ],
194	  });
195
196	  return (
197	    <View
198	      ref={viewRef}
199	      style={{
200	        display: 'block',
201	        height: '100%',
202	        '& .hover-visible': {
203	          opacity: 0,
204	          transition: 'opacity .25s',
205	        },
206	        '&:hover .hover-visible': {
207	          opacity: 1,
208	        },
209	      }}
210	    >
211	      {isEditing && (
212	        <View
213	          className={['hover-visible', NON_DRAGGABLE_AREA_CLASS_NAME].join(' ')}
214	          style={{
215	            position: 'absolute',
216	            top: 7,
217	            right: 3,
218	            zIndex: 1,
219	          }}
220	        >
221	          <Button
222	            ref={triggerRef}
223	            variant="bare"
224	            aria-label={t('Menu')}
225	            onPress={() => {
226	              if (viewRef.current) {
227	                const rect = triggerRef.current?.getBoundingClientRect();
228	                const clientX = rect ? rect.left : 0;
229	                const clientY = rect ? rect.bottom : 0;
230	                viewRef.current.dispatchEvent(
231	                  new MouseEvent('contextmenu', {
232	                    bubbles: true,

234	                    clientY,
235	                  }),
236	                );
237	              }
238	            }}
239	          >
240	            <SvgDotsHorizontalTriple
241	              width={15}
242	              height={15}
243	              style={{ transform: 'rotateZ(90deg)' }}
244	            />
245	          </Button>
246	        </View>
247	      )}
248
249	      {children}
250	    </View>
```

```text
1	import { useEffect, useMemo, useState } from 'react';
2	import type { RefObject } from 'react';
3
4	/**
5	 * Check if the given element (by ref) is visible in the viewport.
6	 */
7	export function useIsInViewport(ref: RefObject<Element | null>) {
8	  const [isIntersecting, setIsIntersecting] = useState(false);
9
10	  const observer = useMemo(
11	    () =>
12	      new IntersectionObserver(([entry]) =>
13	        setIsIntersecting(entry.isIntersecting),
14	      ),
15	    [],
16	  );
17
18	  useEffect(() => {
19	    const view = ref.current;
20
21	    if (!view) {
22	      return;
23	    }
24
25	    observer.observe(view);
26
27	    return () => {
28	      observer.disconnect();
29	    };
30	  }, [ref, observer]);
31
32	  return isIntersecting;
33	}
34
```

```text
44	  toAmount: (value: IntegerAmount) => Amount;
45	  /** Scales a decimal `Amount` up to an `IntegerAmount` for the active currency. */
46	  fromAmount: (value: Amount) => IntegerAmount;
47	  currency: Currency;

49	  hideFraction: boolean;

52	export type FormatResult = {
53	  numericValue?: number;
54	  formattedString: string;
55	};
56
57	function format(
58	  value: unknown,
59	  type: FormatType,
60	  formatter: { format: (value: number) => string },
61	  decimalPlaces: number,
62	): FormatResult {
63	  switch (type) {
64	    case 'string': {
65	      const val = JSON.stringify(value);
66
67	      if (val.charAt(0) === '"' && val.charAt(val.length - 1) === '"') {
68	        return { formattedString: val.slice(1, -1) };
69	      }
70	      return { formattedString: val };
71	    }
72	    case 'number':
73	      if (typeof value !== 'number') {
74	        throw new Error(
75	          'Value is not a number (' + typeof value + '): ' + value,
76	        );
77	      }
78	      return { numericValue: value, formattedString: formatter.format(value) };
79	    case 'percentage':
80	      return { formattedString: value + '%' };
81	    case 'financial-with-sign':
82	    case 'financial-no-decimals':
83	    case 'financial': {
84	      let localValue = value;
85	      if (localValue == null || localValue === '') {
86	        localValue = 0;
87	      } else if (typeof localValue === 'string') {
88	        // This case is generally flawed, but we need to support it for
89	        // backwards compatibility for now.
90	        // For example, it is not clear how the string might look like
91	        // The Budget sends 12300, if the user inputs 123.00, but
92	        // there might be other components that send 123 with the same user input.
93	        // Ideally the string case will be removed in the future. We should always
94	        // use the IntegerAmount.
95	        // The parseInt with the replace is a workaround for the case and looks like
96	        // the "least wrong" solution.
97	        const integerString = localValue.replace(/[^\d-]/g, '');
98	        const parsed = parseInt(integerString, 10);

125	export function useFormat(): UseFormatResult {
126	  const [numberFormatPref] = useSyncedPref('numberFormat');
127	  const [hideFractionPref] = useSyncedPref('hideFraction');
128	  const [defaultCurrencyCodePref] = useSyncedPref('defaultCurrencyCode');
129	  const [symbolPositionPref] = useSyncedPref('currencySymbolPosition');
130	  const [spaceEnabledPref] = useSyncedPref(
131	    'currencySpaceBetweenAmountAndSymbol',
132	  );
133
134	  const activeCurrency = useMemo(() => {
135	    return getCurrency(defaultCurrencyCodePref || '');
136	  }, [defaultCurrencyCodePref]);
137
138	  const numberFormatConfig = useMemo(
139	    () =>
140	      parseNumberFormat({
141	        format: numberFormatPref,
142	        hideFraction: hideFractionPref === 'true',
143	      }),
144	    [numberFormatPref, hideFractionPref],
145	  );
146
147	  // Hack: keep the global number format in sync - update the settings when
148	  // the underlying configuration changes.
149	  // This should be patched by moving all number-formatting utilities away from
150	  // the global `getNumberFormat()` and to using the reactive `useFormat` hook.
151	  useEffect(() => {
152	    setNumberFormat(numberFormatConfig);
153	  }, [numberFormatConfig]);
154
155	  const applyCurrencyStyling = useCallback(
156	    (formattedNumericValue: string, currencySymbol: string): string => {
157	      if (!currencySymbol) {
158	        return formattedNumericValue;
159	      }
160
161	      let sign = '';
162	      let valueWithoutSign = formattedNumericValue;
163	      if (formattedNumericValue.startsWith('-')) {
164	        sign = '-';
165	        valueWithoutSign = formattedNumericValue.slice(1);
166	      }
167
168	      const space = spaceEnabledPref === 'true' ? '\u202F' : '';
169	      const position = symbolPositionPref || 'before';
170
171	      const styledAmount =
172	        position === 'after'
173	          ? `${valueWithoutSign}${space}${currencySymbol}`
174	          : `\u202A${currencySymbol}\u202C${space}${valueWithoutSign}`;
175
176	      return sign + styledAmount;
177	    },
178	    [symbolPositionPref, spaceEnabledPref],
179	  );
180
181	  const formatDisplay = useCallback(
182	    (value: unknown, type: FormatType = 'string'): string => {
183	      const isFinancialType =
184	        type === 'financial' ||
185	        type === 'financial-with-sign' ||
186	        type === 'financial-no-decimals';
187
188	      let displayDecimalPlaces: number | undefined;
189
190	      if (isFinancialType) {
191	        if (type === 'financial-no-decimals' || hideFractionPref === 'true') {
192	          displayDecimalPlaces = 0;
193	        } else {
194	          displayDecimalPlaces = activeCurrency.decimalPlaces;
195	        }
196	      }
197
198	      const intlFormatter = getNumberFormat({
199	        format: numberFormatConfig.format,
200	        decimalPlaces: displayDecimalPlaces,
201	      }).formatter;
202
203	      const { numericValue, formattedString } = format(
204	        value,
205	        type,
206	        intlFormatter,
207	        activeCurrency.decimalPlaces,
208	      );
209
210	      let styledValue = formattedString;
211	      if (isFinancialType && activeCurrency && activeCurrency.code !== '') {
212	        styledValue = applyCurrencyStyling(
213	          formattedString,
214	          activeCurrency.symbol,
215	        );
216	      }
217
218	      if (
219	        type === 'financial-with-sign' &&
220	        numericValue != null &&
221	        numericValue >= 0
222	      ) {
223	        return '+' + styledValue;
224	      }
225	      return styledValue;
226	    },
227	    [
228	      activeCurrency,
229	      numberFormatConfig,
230	      applyCurrencyStyling,
231	      hideFractionPref,
232	    ],
233	  );
234
235	  const toAmount = useCallback(
236	    (value: number) => integerToAmount(value, activeCurrency.decimalPlaces),
237	    [activeCurrency.decimalPlaces],
238	  );
239
240	  const fromAmount = useCallback(
241	    (value: number) => amountToInteger(value, activeCurrency.decimalPlaces),
242	    [activeCurrency.decimalPlaces],
243	  );
244
245	  const forEdit = useCallback(
246	    (value: IntegerAmount, options?: ForEditOptions) => {
247	      const amount = toAmount(value);
248	      const decimalPlaces =
249	        hideFractionPref === 'true' && !options?.keepFraction
250	          ? 0
251	          : activeCurrency.decimalPlaces;
252	      const editFormatter = getNumberFormat({
253	        format: numberFormatConfig.format,
254	        decimalPlaces,
255	      }).formatter;
256	      return editFormatter.format(amount);
257	    },
258	    [
259	      toAmount,
260	      hideFractionPref,
261	      activeCurrency.decimalPlaces,
262	      numberFormatConfig.format,
263	    ],
264	  );
265
266	  const fromEdit = useCallback(
267	    (
268	      value: string,
269	      defaultValue: number | null = null,
270	    ): IntegerAmount | null => {
271	      if (value == null) {
272	        return defaultValue;
273	      }
274
275	      const trimmed = value.trim();
276	      if (trimmed === '') {
277	        return defaultValue;
278	      }
279
280	      // strip directional formatting characters and letters
281	      const normalized = trimmed
282	        .replace(/[\u200E\u200F\u202A-\u202E\u2066-\u2069]/g, '')
283	        .replace(/\p{L}+/gu, '');
284	      let numericValue: number | null = evalArithmetic(normalized, null);
285
286	      if (numericValue === null || isNaN(numericValue)) {
287	        numericValue = currencyToAmount(normalized);
288	      }
289
290	      if (numericValue !== null && !isNaN(numericValue)) {
291	        return fromAmount(numericValue);
292	      }
293
294	      return defaultValue;
295	    },
296	    [fromAmount],
297	  );
298
299	  return Object.assign(formatDisplay, {
300	    forEdit,
301	    fromEdit,
302	    toAmount,
303	    fromAmount,
304	    currency: activeCurrency,
305	    hideFraction: hideFractionPref === 'true',
306	  });
307	}
```

```text
71	// Component that filters text content to remove non-alphanumeric characters
72	// This works by intercepting the actual rendered text via a ref and modifying it
73	function RedactedContent({ children }: RedactedContentProps) {

89	        }
90	      }

92	  }, [children]);

172	function merge(initialValue, ...objects) {
173	  return objects.reduce((prev, current) => {
174	    Object.keys(current).forEach(key => {
175	      const pValue = prev[key];
176	      const cValue = current[key];
177
178	      if (Array.isArray(pValue) && Array.isArray(cValue)) {
179	        prev[key] = pValue.concat(...cValue);
180	      } else if (isObject(pValue) && isObject(cValue)) {
181	        prev[key] = merge(pValue, cValue);
182	      } else {
183	        prev[key] = cValue;
184	      }
185	    });
186	    return prev;
187	  }, initialValue);
188	}
```

```text
7	  addItems,
8	  setContextMenuPosition,
9	} from '#contextmenu/contextMenuSlice';
10	import type { ContextMenuItem } from '#contextmenu/types';
11	import { useRefEventListener } from '#hooks/useRefEventListener';
12	import { useDispatch } from '#redux';
13
14	type UseContextMenuProps = {
15	  triggerRef: RefObject<HTMLElement | null>;
16	  enabled?: boolean;
17	  items: Falsy<ContextMenuItem>[];
18	};
19
20	export function useContextMenu({
21	  triggerRef,
22	  enabled = true,
23	  items,
24	}: UseContextMenuProps) {
25	  const dispatch = useDispatch();
26
27	  // Store actions in a ref to avoid re-binding the event listener on every render
28	  const actionsRef = useRef(items);
29	  actionsRef.current = items;
30
31	  const processedItems = items.filter(
32	    item => item && (typeof item === 'symbol' || !item.hidden),
33	  ) as ContextMenuItem[];
34
35	  useRefEventListener(triggerRef, 'contextmenu', (e: MouseEvent) => {
36	    if (enabled) {
37	      e.preventDefault();
38	      dispatch(addItems(processedItems));
39	      dispatch(setContextMenuPosition({ x: e.clientX, y: e.clientY }));
40	    }
41	  });
42
43	  const handleContextMenu = useCallback(() => {
44	    if (!triggerRef.current || !enabled) return;
45	    const rect = triggerRef.current.getBoundingClientRect();
46	    // prefer MouseEvent bubbling over dispatching events to
47	    // allow nesting context menu actions
48	    triggerRef.current.dispatchEvent(
49	      new MouseEvent('contextmenu', {
50	        clientX: rect.x,
51	        clientY: rect.y + rect.height,
52	        bubbles: true,
53	      }),
54	    );
55	  }, [triggerRef, enabled]);
56
57	  return { handleContextMenu };
58	}
```

```typescript
import React from 'react';

import type { GoalCardWidget } from '@actual-app/core/types/models';
import { act, fireEvent, render, screen } from '@testing-library/react';
import userEvent from '@testing-library/user-event';

import type { ContextMenuItem } from '#contextmenu/types';
import { useNavigate } from '#hooks/useNavigate';
import { createTestAppStore, TestProviders } from '#mocks';

import { GoalCard } from './GoalCard';

vi.mock('#hooks/useNavigate');
// jsdom has no IntersectionObserver; treat the card as always on screen so
// ReportCard renders its children.
vi.mock('#hooks/useIsInViewport', () => ({
  useIsInViewport: () => true,
}));

const WIDGET_ID = 'goal-widget-1';

type Meta = GoalCardWidget['meta'];

function renderGoalCard({
  meta,
  isEditing = false,
  onMetaChange = vi.fn(),
  store = createTestAppStore(),
}: {
  meta?: Meta;
  isEditing?: boolean;
  onMetaChange?: (newMeta: Meta) => void;
  store?: ReturnType<typeof createTestAppStore>;
} = {}) {
  const result = render(
    <TestProviders store={store}>
      <GoalCard
        widgetId={WIDGET_ID}
        isEditing={isEditing}
        meta={meta}
        onMetaChange={onMetaChange}
      />
    </TestProviders>,
  );
  return { ...result, onMetaChange, store };
}

function getProgressFill(container: HTMLElement) {
  const track = container.querySelector('[aria-hidden="true"]');
  const fill = track?.firstElementChild;
  if (!(fill instanceof HTMLElement)) {
    throw new Error('Progress bar not found');
  }
  return fill;
}

describe('GoalCard', () => {
  const mockNavigate = vi.fn();

  beforeEach(() => {
    vi.clearAllMocks();
    vi.mocked(useNavigate).mockReturnValue(mockNavigate);
  });

  describe('name', () => {
    it('shows the goal name from meta', () => {
      renderGoalCard({ meta: { name: 'Emergency fund' } });

      expect(
        screen.getByRole('heading', { name: 'Emergency fund' }),
      ).toBeInTheDocument();
    });

    it('falls back to a default name when none is set', () => {
      renderGoalCard({ meta: {} });

      expect(
        screen.getByRole('heading', { name: 'Personal goal' }),
      ).toBeInTheDocument();
    });
  });

  describe('amounts', () => {
    it('shows the current and target amounts', () => {
      renderGoalCard({
        meta: { currentAmount: 250000, targetAmount: 1000000 },
      });

      expect(screen.getByText('2,500.00')).toBeInTheDocument();
      expect(screen.getByText(/10,000\.00/)).toBeInTheDocument();
    });

    it('shows zero amounts when meta is missing', () => {
      renderGoalCard({ meta: null });

      expect(screen.getAllByText(/0\.00/)).toHaveLength(2);
      expect(screen.getByText('0%')).toBeInTheDocument();
    });
  });

  describe('progress', () => {
    it.each([
      { currentAmount: 250000, targetAmount: 1000000, expected: 25 },
      { currentAmount: 0, targetAmount: 1000000, expected: 0 },
      { currentAmount: 1000000, targetAmount: 1000000, expected: 100 },
      // rounds to the nearest whole percent
      { currentAmount: 1000, targetAmount: 3000, expected: 33 },
      { currentAmount: 2000, targetAmount: 3000, expected: 67 },
      // caps at 100% when the goal is exceeded
      { currentAmount: 1500000, targetAmount: 1000000, expected: 100 },
      // never goes below 0% for a negative balance
      { currentAmount: -50000, targetAmount: 1000000, expected: 0 },
      // no target set avoids dividing by zero
      { currentAmount: 50000, targetAmount: 0, expected: 0 },
    ])(
      'shows $expected% for $currentAmount of $targetAmount',
      ({ currentAmount, targetAmount, expected }) => {
        const { container } = renderGoalCard({
          meta: { currentAmount, targetAmount },
        });

        expect(screen.getByText(`${expected}%`)).toBeInTheDocument();
        expect(getComputedStyle(getProgressFill(container)).width).toBe(
          `${expected}%`,
        );
      },
    );

    it('updates when the goal amounts change', () => {
      const store = createTestAppStore();
      const { rerender, container } = renderGoalCard({
        meta: { currentAmount: 100000, targetAmount: 1000000 },
        store,
      });
      expect(screen.getByText('10%')).toBeInTheDocument();

      rerender(
        <TestProviders store={store}>
          <GoalCard
            widgetId={WIDGET_ID}
            meta={{ currentAmount: 600000, targetAmount: 1000000 }}
            onMetaChange={vi.fn()}
          />
        </TestProviders>,
      );

      expect(screen.getByText('60%')).toBeInTheDocument();
      expect(getComputedStyle(getProgressFill(container)).width).toBe('60%');
    });
  });

  describe('navigation', () => {
    it('opens the goal report for this widget when clicked', async () => {
      const user = userEvent.setup();
      renderGoalCard({ meta: { name: 'Vacation' } });

      await user.click(screen.getByRole('button'));

      expect(mockNavigate).toHaveBeenCalledWith(`/reports/goal/${WIDGET_ID}`, {
        state: { goBack: true },
      });
    });

    it('does not navigate while the dashboard is being edited', async () => {
      const user = userEvent.setup();
      renderGoalCard({ meta: { name: 'Vacation' }, isEditing: true });

      await user.click(screen.getByRole('heading', { name: 'Vacation' }));

      expect(mockNavigate).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    });
  });

  describe('renaming', () => {
    it('saves the new name and keeps the goal amounts', async () => {
      const user = userEvent.setup();
      const meta: Meta = {
        name: 'Vacation',
        currentAmount: 250000,
        targetAmount: 1000000,
      };
      const { onMetaChange, store } = renderGoalCard({ meta });

      // Open the card's context menu and choose "Rename".
      fireEvent.contextMenu(screen.getByRole('heading', { name: 'Vacation' }));
      const renameItem = store
        .getState()
        .contextMenu.items.find(
          (item): item is Exclude<ContextMenuItem, symbol> =>
            typeof item === 'object' && item.name === 'rename',
        );
      expect(renameItem).toBeDefined();
      act(() => renameItem?.onClick?.());

      const input = screen.getByRole('textbox');
      await user.clear(input);
      await user.type(input, 'Trip to Japan{Enter}');

      expect(onMetaChange).toHaveBeenCalledWith({
        name: 'Trip to Japan',
        currentAmount: 250000,
        targetAmount: 1000000,
      });
    });
  });
});
```

I've added 16 tests for the Goal card in [GoalCard.test.tsx](packages/desktop-client/src/components/reports/reports/GoalCard.test.tsx). They all pass, and typecheck is clean. As a check, I briefly removed the 100% cap from the progress math, and the "goal exceeded" test failed as it should. Then I put the code back.

What the tests cover:

- **Name:** shows the name saved on the widget, or "Personal goal" when none is set.
- **Amounts:** shows the current and target amounts formatted as money, and shows zeros when the widget has no data yet.
- **Progress:** each case checks both the percentage text and the bar's width:
  - 25% partway to the goal, 0% with nothing saved, 100% when the goal is met exactly
  - rounding to a whole percent (33% and 67%)
  - capped at 100% when the goal is exceeded
  - 0% for a negative balance
  - 0% when no target is set, so there's no divide-by-zero
- **Updates:** the percentage and bar change when the amounts change.
- **Navigation:** clicking the card opens `/reports/goal/<widgetId>`, and clicking does nothing while the dashboard is being edited.
- **Rename:** renaming from the card's right-click menu saves the new name and keeps the current and target amounts.

The tests replace two hooks with stand-ins: the one that checks whether the card is on screen (the test environment can't detect that, so it always says "on screen"), and `useNavigate`. Everything else uses the real store and formatting code.

**Something to know about `yarn lint:fix`:** running it in both turns reformatted about 30 unrelated files that already had formatting problems on this branch. These included the ai-logs, `TransactionsTable.tsx`, and a missing space after `) :` in `Overview.tsx`. I undid all of those, so the only real changes now are the Goal work: `ReportRouter.tsx`, `GoalCard.tsx`, `GoalReport.tsx` and the new test file. `git status` still lists about 40 files under `packages/api`, `loot-core`, `crdt` and other packages as modified, but `git diff` on them is empty, so nothing would get committed. Those files likely just need their saved line endings or timestamps reset. If you want the `Overview.tsx` spacing fix, it's best done as its own small commit.

```text
532	type OperatorProps = {

540	function Operator({
541	  type,
542	  dividendFilterObject,
543	  divisorFilterObject,
544	  fromRange,

546	  showDivisorDateRange,
```

```text
11	import type { useSpreadsheet } from '#hooks/useSpreadsheet';

14	export function summarySpreadsheet(
15	  start: string,
16	  end: string,
17	  conditions: RuleConditionEntity[] = [],
18	  conditionsOp: 'and' | 'or' = 'and',
19	  summaryContent: SummaryContent,
20	  locale: Locale,
21	) {
22	  return async (
23	    spreadsheet: ReturnType<typeof useSpreadsheet>,
24	    setData: (data: {

29	      toRange: string;

31	  ) => {
32	    let filters: unknown[] = [];
33	    try {
34	      const response = await send('make-filters-from-conditions', {
35	        conditions: conditions.filter(cond => !cond.customName),
36	      });
37	      filters = response.filters;
38	    } catch (error) {
39	      console.error('Error fetching filters:', error);
40	    }
41	    const conditionsOpKey = conditionsOp === 'or' ? '$or' : '$and';
42
43	    let startDay: Date;
44	    let endDay: Date;
45	    try {
46	      startDay = d.parse(
47	        monthUtils.firstDayOfMonth(start),
48	        'yyyy-MM-dd',
49	        new Date(),
50	      );
51
52	      endDay = d.parse(
53	        monthUtils.getMonth(end) ===
54	          monthUtils.getMonth(monthUtils.currentDay())
55	          ? monthUtils.currentDay()
56	          : monthUtils.lastDayOfMonth(end),
57	        'yyyy-MM-dd',
58	        new Date(),
59	      );
60	    } catch (error) {
61	      console.error('Error parsing dates:', error);
62	      throw new Error('Invalid date format provided');
63	    }
64
65	    if (!d.isValid(startDay) || !d.isValid(endDay)) {
66	      throw new Error('Invalid date values provided');
67	    }
68
69	    if (d.isAfter(startDay, endDay)) {
70	      throw new Error('Start date must be before or equal to end date.');
71	    }
72
73	    const getOneDatePerMonth = (start: Date, end: Date) => {
74	      const months = [];
75	      let currentDate = d.startOfMonth(start);
76
77	      while (!d.isSameMonth(currentDate, end)) {
78	        months.push(currentDate);
79	        currentDate = d.addMonths(currentDate, 1);
80	      }
81	      months.push(end);
82
83	      return months;
84	    };

98	              },
99	            },
100	          ],
101	        })
102	        .filter({

151	          divisor: data.data[0].count,
152	        });
153	        break;
154

158	        break;

187	function calculatePerMonth(
188	  data: Array<{
189	    date: string;
190	    amount: number;
191	    count: number;
192	  }>,
193	  months: Date[],
194	) {
195	  if (!data.length || !months.length) {
196	    return { total: 0, dividend: 0, divisor: 0 };
197	  }
198
199	  const monthlyData = data.reduce(
200	    (acc, day) => {
201	      const monthKey = d.format(
202	        d.parse(day.date, 'yyyy-MM-dd', new Date()),
203	        'yyyy-MM',
204	      );
205	      acc[monthKey] = (acc[monthKey] || 0) + day.amount;
206	      return acc;
207	    },
208	    {} as Record<string, number>,
209	  );
210
211	  const monthsSum = months.map(m => ({
212	    amount: monthlyData[d.format(m, 'yyyy-MM')] || 0,
213	  }));
214
215	  const lastMonth = months.at(-1)!;
216	  const dayOfMonth = lastMonth.getDate();
217	  const daysInMonth = monthUtils.getDay(monthUtils.lastDayOfMonth(lastMonth));
218	  const numMonths = months.length - 1 + dayOfMonth / daysInMonth;
219
220	  const totalAmount = monthsSum.reduce((sum, month) => sum + month.amount, 0);
221	  const averageAmountPerMonth = totalAmount / numMonths;
222
223	  return {
224	    total: averageAmountPerMonth,
225	    dividend: totalAmount,
226	    divisor: numMonths,
227	  };
228	}
229
230	function calculatePerYear(
231	  data: Array<{
232	    date: string;
233	    amount: number;
234	    count: number;
235	  }>,
236	  startDate: Date,
237	  endDate: Date,
238	) {
239	  if (!data.length) {
240	    return { total: 0, dividend: 0, divisor: 0 };
241	  }
242
243	  const totalAmount = data.reduce((sum, day) => sum + day.amount, 0);
244	  const totalDays = d.differenceInDays(endDate, startDate) + 1;
245	  const numYears = totalDays / 365.25;
246
247	  const averageAmountPerYear = totalAmount / numYears;
248
249	  return {
250	    total: averageAmountPerYear,
251	    dividend: totalAmount,
252	    divisor: numYears,
253	  };
254	}
255
256	async function calculatePercentage(
257	  data: Array<{
258	    amount: number;
259	  }>,
260	  summaryContent: SummaryContent,
261	  startDay: Date,
262	  endDay: Date,
263	) {
264	  if (summaryContent.type !== 'percentage') {
265	    return {
266	      total: 0,
267	      dividend: 0,
268	      divisor: 0,
269	    };
270	  }
271
272	  const conditionsOpKey =
273	    summaryContent.divisorConditionsOp === 'or' ? '$or' : '$and';
274	  let filters = [];
275	  try {
276	    const response = await send('make-filters-from-conditions', {
277	      conditions: summaryContent?.divisorConditions?.filter(
278	        cond => !cond.customName,
279	      ),
280	    });
281	    filters = response.filters;
282	  } catch (error) {
283	    console.error('Error creating filters:', error);
284	    return {
285	      total: 0,
286	      dividend: 0,
287	      divisor: 0,
288	    };
289	  }
290
291	  const makeDivisorQuery = () =>
292	    q('transactions')
293	      .filter({
294	        [conditionsOpKey]: filters,
295	      })
296	      .select([{ amount: { $sum: '$amount' } }]);
297
298	  let query = makeDivisorQuery();
299
300	  if (!(summaryContent.divisorAllTimeDateRange ?? false)) {
301	    query = query.filter({
302	      $and: [
303	        {
304	          date: {
305	            $gte: d.format(startDay, 'yyyy-MM-dd'),
306	          },
307	        },
308	        {
309	          date: {
310	            $lte: d.format(endDay, 'yyyy-MM-dd'),
311	          },
312	        },
313	      ],
314	    });
315	  }
316
317	  let divisorData;
318	  try {
319	    divisorData = (await aqlQuery(query)) as { data: { amount: number }[] };
320	  } catch (error) {
321	    console.error('Error executing divisor query:', error);
322	    return {
323	      total: 0,
324	      dividend: 0,
325	      divisor: 0,
326	    };
327	  }
328
329	  const divisorValue = divisorData?.data?.[0]?.amount ?? 0;
330
331	  const dividend = data.reduce((prev, ac) => prev + (ac?.amount ?? 0), 0);
332	  return {
333	    total: Math.round(((dividend ?? 0) / (divisorValue ?? 1)) * 10000) / 100,
334	    divisor: divisorValue ?? 0,
335	    dividend: dividend ?? 0,
336	  };
337	}
```

```text
1	import { useCallback, useMemo, useState } from 'react';

3	import type { RuleConditionEntity } from '@actual-app/core/types/models';
4
5	export function useRuleConditionFilters<T extends RuleConditionEntity>(
6	  initialConditions: T[] = [],
7	  initialConditionsOp: 'and' | 'or' = 'and',
8	) {
9	  const [conditions, setConditions] = useState<T[]>(initialConditions);
10	  const [conditionsOp, setConditionsOp] = useState<'and' | 'or'>(
11	    initialConditionsOp,
12	  );
13	  const [saved, setSaved] = useState<T[] | null>(null);
14
15	  const onApply = useCallback(
16	    (
17	      conditionsOrSavedFilter:
18	        | null
19	        | { conditions: T[]; conditionsOp: 'and' | 'or'; id: T[] | null }
20	        | T,
21	    ) => {
22	      if (conditionsOrSavedFilter === null) {
23	        setConditions([]);
24	        setSaved(null);
25	      } else if ('conditions' in conditionsOrSavedFilter) {
26	        setConditions([...conditionsOrSavedFilter.conditions]);
27	        setConditionsOp(conditionsOrSavedFilter.conditionsOp);
28	        setSaved(conditionsOrSavedFilter.id);
29	      } else {
30	        setConditions(state => [...state, conditionsOrSavedFilter]);
31	        setSaved(null);
32	      }
33	    },
34	    [setConditions],
35	  );
36
37	  const onUpdate = useCallback(
38	    (oldFilter: T, updatedFilter: T) => {
39	      setConditions(state =>
40	        state.map(f => (f === oldFilter ? updatedFilter : f)),
41	      );
42	      setSaved(null);
43	    },
44	    [setConditions],
45	  );
46
47	  const onDelete = useCallback(
48	    (deletedFilter: T) => {
49	      setConditions(state => state.filter(f => f !== deletedFilter));
50	      setSaved(null);
51	    },
52	    [setConditions],
53	  );
54
55	  return useMemo(
56	    () => ({
57	      conditions,
58	      saved,
59	      conditionsOp,
60	      onApply,
61	      onUpdate,
62	      onDelete,
63	      onConditionsOpChange: setConditionsOp,
64	    }),
65	    [
66	      conditions,
67	      saved,
68	      onApply,
69	      onUpdate,
70	      onDelete,
71	      setConditionsOp,
72	      conditionsOp,
73	    ],
74	  );
75	}
76
```

```text
5	export function makeQuery(

35	    })
36	    //Show assets or debts
37	    .filter(
38	      name === 'assets' ? { amount: { $gt: 0 } } : { amount: { $lt: 0 } },

42	    .groupBy([

45	      { $id: '$payee' },
46	      { $id: '$category' },
47	      { $id: '$payee.transfer_acct.id' },
48	    ])

58	      { payee: { $id: '$payee.id' } },
```

## 2. How the Summary total is computed

- **Sum query.** `components/reports/spreadsheets/summary-spreadsheet.ts:14-185`:
  - It converts conditions into query filters with `send('make-filters-from-conditions', { conditions: conditions.filter(c => !c.customName) })` and uses `$or` or `$and` depending on `conditionsOp`.

- Spending does not break down by category for actuals; it only groups budgets with `.groupBy([{ $id: '$category' }])` (`spending-spreadsheet.ts:218`).

<tool-use data-tool-type="generic" data-tool-name="AskUserQuestion"><details>

<summary>Tool use: **AskUserQuestion**</summary>
**Where should the goal's progress number come from?**

Options:

- **Computed from transactions (Recommended)** - Current amount = sum of transactions matching the conditions over the timeFrame. Card and report both compute it; meta.currentAmount stops being the source of truth. GoalCard tests get updated.
- **Keep stored currentAmount** - Progress stays meta.currentAmount. The report just lists matching transactions as context alongside it.

**How should the report break down what's driving progress?** _(select multiple)_

Options:

- **By category** - Table of categories with their summed contribution.
- **By payee** - Table of payees with their summed contribution.
- **By month** - Contribution per month across the time frame (shows pace).
- **By account** - Contribution per account.

**How should transaction signs count toward the goal?**

Options:

- **Net sum as-is (Recommended)** - Deposits add, withdrawals subtract — fits savings goals. Users target spending by filtering conditions; negative totals show 0% progress.
- **Absolute value of the net sum** - Treat the total's magnitude as progress, so a spending goal (negative total) also fills the bar.

**Should the report page also let users set the target amount?**

Options:

- **Yes, editable target (Recommended)** - Add a target amount input next to the filters; saved with the widget along with conditions and timeFrame.
- **No, not yet** - Only conditions + timeFrame are editable here; target stays as-is.

**Answer:** Computed from transactions (Recommended), By category, By month, Net sum as-is (Recommended), Yes, editable target (Recommended)

</details></tool-use>

```text
107	          { amount: { $sum: '$amount' } },
108	          { count: { $count: '*' } },
109	        ]);
110
111	    let query = makeRootQuery();
112
113	    if (
114	      summaryContent.type === 'avgPerMonth' ||
115	      summaryContent.type === 'avgPerYear'
116	    ) {
117	      query = query.groupBy(['date']);
118	    }
119
120	    let data;
121	    try {
122	      data = await aqlQuery(query);
123	    } catch (error) {
124	      console.error('Error executing query:', error);
125	      return;
126	    }
127
128	    const dateRanges = {
129	      fromRange: d.format(startDay, 'MMM yy', { locale }),
130	      toRange: d.format(endDay, 'MMM yy', { locale }),
131	    };
132
133	    switch (summaryContent.type) {
134	      case 'sum':
135	        setData({
136	          ...dateRanges,
137	          total: data.data[0]?.amount ?? 0,
138	          dividend: data.data[0]?.amount ?? 0,
139	          divisor: 0,
140	        });
141	        break;
142
143	      case 'avgPerTransact':
144	        setData({
145	          ...dateRanges,
146	          total:
147	            (data.data[0]?.count ?? 0)
148	              ? (data.data[0]?.amount ?? 0) / data.data[0].count
149	              : 0,
150	          dividend: data.data[0]?.amount ?? 0,
151	          divisor: data.data[0].count,
152	        });
153	        break;
154
155	      case 'avgPerMonth': {
156	        const months = getOneDatePerMonth(startDay, endDay);
157	        setData({ ...dateRanges, ...calculatePerMonth(data.data, months) });
158	        break;
159	      }
160
161	      case 'avgPerYear': {
162	        setData({
163	          ...dateRanges,
164	          ...calculatePerYear(data.data, startDay, endDay),
165	        });
166	        break;
167	      }
168
169	      case 'percentage':
170	        setData({
171	          ...dateRanges,
172	          ...(await calculatePercentage(
173	            data.data,
174	            summaryContent,
175	            startDay,
176	            endDay,
177	          )),
178	        });
179	        break;
180
181	      default:
182	        throw new Error(`Unsupported summary type`);
183	    }
184	  };
185	}
186
187	function calculatePerMonth(
188	  data: Array<{
189	    date: string;
190	    amount: number;
191	    count: number;
192	  }>,
193	  months: Date[],
194	) {
195	  if (!data.length || !months.length) {
196	    return { total: 0, dividend: 0, divisor: 0 };
197	  }
198
199	  const monthlyData = data.reduce(
200	    (acc, day) => {
201	      const monthKey = d.format(
202	        d.parse(day.date, 'yyyy-MM-dd', new Date()),
203	        'yyyy-MM',
204	      );
205	      acc[monthKey] = (acc[monthKey] || 0) + day.amount;
206	      return acc;
207	    },
208	    {} as Record<string, number>,
209	  );
210
211	  const monthsSum = months.map(m => ({
212	    amount: monthlyData[d.format(m, 'yyyy-MM')] || 0,
213	  }));
214
215	  const lastMonth = months.at(-1)!;
216	  const dayOfMonth = lastMonth.getDate();
217	  const daysInMonth = monthUtils.getDay(monthUtils.lastDayOfMonth(lastMonth));
218	  const numMonths = months.length - 1 + dayOfMonth / daysInMonth;
219
220	  const totalAmount = monthsSum.reduce((sum, month) => sum + month.amount, 0);
221	  const averageAmountPerMonth = totalAmount / numMonths;
222
223	  return {
224	    total: averageAmountPerMonth,
225	    dividend: totalAmount,
226	    divisor: numMonths,
227	  };
228	}
229
230	function calculatePerYear(
231	  data: Array<{
232	    date: string;
233	    amount: number;
234	    count: number;
235	  }>,
236	  startDate: Date,
237	  endDate: Date,
238	) {
239	  if (!data.length) {
240	    return { total: 0, dividend: 0, divisor: 0 };
241	  }
242
243	  const totalAmount = data.reduce((sum, day) => sum + day.amount, 0);
244	  const totalDays = d.differenceInDays(endDate, startDate) + 1;
245	  const numYears = totalDays / 365.25;
246
247	  const averageAmountPerYear = totalAmount / numYears;
248
249	  return {
250	    total: averageAmountPerYear,
251	    dividend: totalAmount,
252	    divisor: numYears,
253	  };
254	}
255
256	async function calculatePercentage(
257	  data: Array<{
258	    amount: number;
259	  }>,
260	  summaryContent: SummaryContent,
261	  startDay: Date,
262	  endDay: Date,
263	) {
264	  if (summaryContent.type !== 'percentage') {
265	    return {
266	      total: 0,
267	      dividend: 0,
268	      divisor: 0,
269	    };
270	  }
271
272	  const conditionsOpKey =
273	    summaryContent.divisorConditionsOp === 'or' ? '$or' : '$and';
274	  let filters = [];
275	  try {
276	    const response = await send('make-filters-from-conditions', {
277	      conditions: summaryContent?.divisorConditions?.filter(
278	        cond => !cond.customName,
279	      ),
280	    });
281	    filters = response.filters;
282	  } catch (error) {
283	    console.error('Error creating filters:', error);
284	    return {
285	      total: 0,
286	      dividend: 0,
287	      divisor: 0,
288	    };
289	  }
290
291	  const makeDivisorQuery = () =>
292	    q('transactions')
293	      .filter({
294	        [conditionsOpKey]: filters,
295	      })
296	      .select([{ amount: { $sum: '$amount' } }]);
297
298	  let query = makeDivisorQuery();
299
300	  if (!(summaryContent.divisorAllTimeDateRange ?? false)) {
301	    query = query.filter({
302	      $and: [
303	        {
304	          date: {
305	            $gte: d.format(startDay, 'yyyy-MM-dd'),
306	          },
307	        },
308	        {
309	          date: {
310	            $lte: d.format(endDay, 'yyyy-MM-dd'),
311	          },
312	        },
313	      ],
314	    });
315	  }
316
317	  let divisorData;
318	  try {
319	    divisorData = (await aqlQuery(query)) as { data: { amount: number }[] };
320	  } catch (error) {
321	    console.error('Error executing divisor query:', error);
322	    return {
323	      total: 0,
324	      dividend: 0,
325	      divisor: 0,
326	    };
327	  }
328
329	  const divisorValue = divisorData?.data?.[0]?.amount ?? 0;
330
331	  const dividend = data.reduce((prev, ac) => prev + (ac?.amount ?? 0), 0);
332	  return {
333	    total: Math.round(((dividend ?? 0) / (divisorValue ?? 1)) * 10000) / 100,
334	    divisor: divisorValue ?? 0,
335	    dividend: dividend ?? 0,
336	  };
337	}
338
```

```text
4
5	export function useReport<T>(
6	  sheetName: string,
7	  getData: (
8	    spreadsheet: ReturnType<typeof useSpreadsheet>,
9	    setData: (results: T) => void,
10	  ) => Promise<void>,
11	): T | null {
12	  const spreadsheet = useSpreadsheet();
13	  const [results, setResults] = useState<T | null>(null);
14
15	  useEffect(() => {
16	    let didCancel = false;
17
18	    // Reset results whenever a new data function is provided so callers
19	    // can reliably show a loading state instead of stale/partial data.
20	    setResults(null);
21
22	    void getData(spreadsheet, results => {
23	      if (!didCancel) {
24	        setResults(results);
25	      }
26	    });
27
28	    return () => {
29	      didCancel = true;
30	    };
31	  }, [getData, spreadsheet]);
32	  return results;
33	}
```

```text
24	type CellCacheValue = { name: string; value: string | number | boolean | null };
25	type CellCache = { [name: string]: Promise<CellCacheValue> | null };
26	type CellObserverCallback = (node: CellCacheValue) => void;
27	type CellObservers = { [name: string]: CellObserverCallback[] };

29	const GLOBAL_SHEET_NAME = '__global';

31	function makeSpreadsheet() {
32	  const cellObservers: CellObservers = {};
33	  const LRUValueCache = new LRUCache<string, CellCacheValue>({ max: 1200 });
34	  const cellCache: CellCache = {};
35	  let observersDisabled = false;
36
37	  class Spreadsheet {
38	    observeCell(name: string, callback: CellObserverCallback): () => void {
39	      if (!cellObservers[name]) {
40	        cellObservers[name] = [];
41	      }
42	      cellObservers[name].push(callback);
43
44	      return () => {
45	        cellObservers[name] = cellObservers[name].filter(cb => cb !== callback);
46
47	        if (cellObservers[name].length === 0) {
48	          cellCache[name] = null;
49	        }
50	      };
51	    }
52
53	    disableObservers(): void {
54	      observersDisabled = true;
55	    }
56
57	    enableObservers(): void {
58	      observersDisabled = false;
59	    }
60
61	    prewarmCache(name: string, value: CellCacheValue): void {
62	      LRUValueCache.set(name, value);
63	    }
64
65	    listen(): () => void {
66	      return listen('cells-changed', event => {
67	        if (!observersDisabled) {
68	          // TODO: batch react so only renders once
69	          event.forEach(node => {
70	            const observers = cellObservers[node.name];
71	            if (observers) {
72	              observers.forEach(func => func(node));
73	              cellCache[node.name] = Promise.resolve(node);
74	              LRUValueCache.set(node.name, node);
75	            }
76	          });
77	        }
78	      });
79	    }
80

82	      sheetName: string = GLOBAL_SHEET_NAME,
83	      binding: Binding,
84	      callback: CellObserverCallback,
85	    ): () => void {
86	      binding = typeof binding === 'string' ? { name: binding } : binding;
87
88	      if (binding.query) {

90	      }

92	      const resolvedName = `${sheetName}!${binding.name}`;
```
