```typescript
import { send } from '@actual-app/core/platform/client/connection';
import * as monthUtils from '@actual-app/core/shared/months';
import { q } from '@actual-app/core/shared/query';
import type { RuleConditionEntity } from '@actual-app/core/types/models';

import type { useSpreadsheet } from '#hooks/useSpreadsheet';
import { aqlQuery } from '#queries/aqlQuery';

export type GoalCategoryContribution = {
  categoryId: string | null;
  amount: number;
};

export type GoalMonthContribution = {
  month: string;
  amount: number;
  cumulative: number;
};

export type GoalData = {
  total: number;
  count: number;
  startDate: string;
  endDate: string;
  byCategory: GoalCategoryContribution[];
  byMonth: GoalMonthContribution[];
};

type GoalSpreadsheetOptions = {
  includeBreakdown?: boolean;
};

export function goalSpreadsheet(
  start: string,
  end: string,
  conditions: RuleConditionEntity[] = [],
  conditionsOp: 'and' | 'or' = 'and',
  { includeBreakdown = false }: GoalSpreadsheetOptions = {},
) {
  return async (
    _spreadsheet: ReturnType<typeof useSpreadsheet>,
    setData: (data: GoalData) => void,
  ) => {
    let filters: unknown[] = [];
    try {
      const response = await send('make-filters-from-conditions', {
        conditions: conditions.filter(cond => !cond.customName),
      });
      filters = response.filters;
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Error fetching filters:', error);
    }

    const { startDate, endDate } = getGoalDateRange(start, end);
    const baseQuery = makeGoalQuery(startDate, endDate, conditionsOp, filters);

    try {
      const [totals, byCategory, byMonth] = await Promise.all([
        aqlQuery(
          baseQuery.select([
            { amount: { $sum: '$amount' } },
            { count: { $count: '*' } },
          ]),
        ),
        includeBreakdown
          ? aqlQuery(
              baseQuery
                .groupBy([{ $id: '$category' }])
                .select([
                  { category: { $id: '$category.id' } },
                  { amount: { $sum: '$amount' } },
                ]),
            )
          : null,
        includeBreakdown
          ? aqlQuery(
              baseQuery
                .groupBy({ $month: '$date' })
                .select([
                  { date: { $month: '$date' } },
                  { amount: { $sum: '$amount' } },
                ]),
            )
          : null,
      ]);

      setData({
        total: totals.data[0]?.amount ?? 0,
        count: totals.data[0]?.count ?? 0,
        startDate,
        endDate,
        byCategory: byCategory
          ? sortCategoryContributions(byCategory.data)
          : [],
        byMonth: byMonth
          ? fillMonthContributions(byMonth.data, startDate, endDate)
          : [],
      });
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Error executing goal query:', error);
    }
  };
}

/**
 * The inclusive date range a goal covers. Ranges ending in the current month
 * stop at today so future-dated transactions don't count as progress yet.
 */
export function getGoalDateRange(start: string, end: string) {
  const startDate = monthUtils.firstDayOfMonth(start);
  const endDate =
    monthUtils.getMonth(end) === monthUtils.getMonth(monthUtils.currentDay())
      ? monthUtils.currentDay()
      : monthUtils.lastDayOfMonth(end);
  return { startDate, endDate };
}

/**
 * The transactions that count toward a goal, before any select/groupBy.
 */
export function makeGoalQuery(
  startDate: string,
  endDate: string,
  conditionsOp: 'and' | 'or',
  filters: unknown[],
) {
  const conditionsOpKey = conditionsOp === 'or' ? '$or' : '$and';
  return q('transactions')
    .filter({
      $and: [{ date: { $gte: startDate } }, { date: { $lte: endDate } }],
    })
    .filter({ [conditionsOpKey]: filters });
}

/**
 * Whole-number percent of the target reached, clamped to 0-100.
 */
export function calculateGoalProgress(
  currentAmount: number,
  targetAmount: number,
) {
  if (targetAmount <= 0) {
    return 0;
  }
  const progress = Math.min(Math.max(currentAmount / targetAmount, 0), 1);
  return Math.round(progress * 100);
}

/**
 * Largest contributors first, in either direction.
 */
export function sortCategoryContributions(
  rows: Array<{ category: string | null; amount: number }>,
): GoalCategoryContribution[] {
  return rows
    .filter(row => row.amount !== 0)
    .map(row => ({ categoryId: row.category ?? null, amount: row.amount }))
    .sort((a, b) => Math.abs(b.amount) - Math.abs(a.amount));
}

/**
 * One entry per month in the range (months without transactions are 0),
 * with a running total so the pace toward the goal is visible.
 */
export function fillMonthContributions(
  rows: Array<{ date: string; amount: number }>,
  startDate: string,
  endDate: string,
): GoalMonthContribution[] {
  const amountsByMonth = new Map(rows.map(row => [row.date, row.amount]));

  let cumulative = 0;
  return monthUtils
    .rangeInclusive(
      monthUtils.monthFromDate(startDate),
      monthUtils.monthFromDate(endDate),
    )
    .map(month => {
      const amount = amountsByMonth.get(month) ?? 0;
      cumulative += amount;
      return { month, amount, cumulative };
    });
}
```

import React, { useEffect, useMemo, useState } from 'react';
import { Trans, useTranslation } from 'react-i18next';

import { Block } from '@actual-app/components/block';
import { styles } from '@actual-app/components/styles';
import { theme } from '@actual-app/components/theme';
import { View } from '@actual-app/components/view';
import { send } from '@actual-app/core/platform/client/connection';
import * as monthUtils from '@actual-app/core/shared/months';
import type { GoalCardWidget } from '@actual-app/core/types/models';
import type { TransObjectLiteral } from '@actual-app/core/types/util';

import { FinancialText } from '#components/FinancialText';
import { PrivacyFilter } from '#components/PrivacyFilter';
import { DateRange } from '#components/reports/DateRange';
import { GoalProgressBar } from '#components/reports/GoalProgressBar';
import { ReportCard } from '#components/reports/ReportCard';
import { ReportCardName } from '#components/reports/ReportCardName';
import { ReportCardValueSkeleton } from '#components/reports/ReportCardValueSkeleton';
import { calculateTimeRange } from '#components/reports/reportRanges';
import {
  calculateGoalProgress,
  goalSpreadsheet,
} from '#components/reports/spreadsheets/goal-spreadsheet';
import { useReport } from '#components/reports/useReport';
import { useFormat } from '#hooks/useFormat';

type GoalCardProps = {
  widgetId: string;
  isEditing?: boolean;
  meta?: GoalCardWidget['meta'];
  onMetaChange: (newMeta: GoalCardWidget['meta']) => void;
};

export function GoalCard({
  widgetId,
  isEditing,
  meta = {},
  onMetaChange,
}: GoalCardProps) {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const format = useFormat();

  const [nameMenuOpen, setNameMenuOpen] = useState(false);
  const [isCardHovered, setIsCardHovered] = useState(false);
  const [latestTransaction, setLatestTransaction] = useState('');

  useEffect(() => {
    async function fetchLatestTransaction() {
      const latestTrans = await send('get-latest-transaction');
      setLatestTransaction(
        latestTrans ? latestTrans.date : monthUtils.currentDay(),
      );
    }
    void fetchLatestTransaction();
  }, []);

  const [start, end] = calculateTimeRange(
    meta?.timeFrame,
    {
      start: monthUtils.dayFromDate(monthUtils.currentMonth()),
      end: monthUtils.currentDay(),
      mode: 'full',
    },
    latestTransaction,
  );

  const params = useMemo(
    () => goalSpreadsheet(start, end, meta?.conditions, meta?.conditionsOp),
    [start, end, meta?.conditions, meta?.conditionsOp],
  );
  const data = useReport('goal', params);

  const currentAmount = data?.total ?? 0;
  const targetAmount = meta?.targetAmount ?? 0;
  const progressPercent = calculateGoalProgress(currentAmount, targetAmount);

  return (
    <ReportCard
      widgetId={widgetId}
      isEditing={isEditing}
      disableClick={nameMenuOpen}
      to={`/reports/goal/${widgetId}`}
      onRename={() => setNameMenuOpen(true)}
    >
      <View
        style={{ flex: 1 }}
        onPointerEnter={() => setIsCardHovered(true)}
        onPointerLeave={() => setIsCardHovered(false)}
      >
        <View style={{ flexDirection: 'row', padding: 20 }}>
          <View style={{ flex: 1 }}>
            <ReportCardName
              name={meta?.name || t('Personal goal')}
              isEditing={nameMenuOpen}
              onChange={newName => {
                onMetaChange({
                  ...meta,
                  name: newName,
                });
                setNameMenuOpen(false);
              }}
              onClose={() => setNameMenuOpen(false)}
            />
            <DateRange start={start} end={end} />
          </View>
          <View style={{ textAlign: 'right' }}>
            <Block
              style={{
                ...styles.mediumText,
                fontWeight: 500,
                marginBottom: 5,
              }}
            >
              <PrivacyFilter activationFilters={[!isCardHovered]}>
                <FinancialText>
                  {format(currentAmount, 'financial')}
                </FinancialText>
              </PrivacyFilter>
            </Block>
            <Block style={{ color: theme.pageTextSubdued }}>
              <PrivacyFilter activationFilters={[!isCardHovered]}>
                <Trans>
                  of{' '}
                  <FinancialText>
                    {
                      {
                        targetAmount: format(targetAmount, 'financial'),
                      } as TransObjectLiteral
                    }
                  </FinancialText>
                </Trans>
              </PrivacyFilter>
            </Block>
          </View>
        </View>

        <View
          style={{
            flex: 1,
            justifyContent: 'center',
            paddingLeft: 20,
            paddingRight: 20,
            paddingBottom: 20,
          }}
        >
          {data ? (
            <GoalProgressBar percent={progressPercent} />
          ) : (
            <ReportCardValueSkeleton />
          )}
        </View>
      </View>
    </ReportCard>
  );
}

```

import type { ReactNode } from 'react';
import { Trans, useTranslation } from 'react-i18next';

import { Block } from '@actual-app/components/block';
import { styles } from '@actual-app/components/styles';
import { theme } from '@actual-app/components/theme';
import { View } from '@actual-app/components/view';
import * as monthUtils from '@actual-app/core/shared/months';
import type { CategoryEntity } from '@actual-app/core/types/models';

import { FinancialText } from '#components/FinancialText';
import { PrivacyFilter } from '#components/PrivacyFilter';
import type {
  GoalCategoryContribution,
  GoalMonthContribution,
} from '#components/reports/spreadsheets/goal-spreadsheet';
import { useFormat } from '#hooks/useFormat';
import { useLocale } from '#hooks/useLocale';

type GoalBreakdownProps = {
  byCategory: GoalCategoryContribution[];
  byMonth: GoalMonthContribution[];
  categories: CategoryEntity[];
  isNarrowWidth: boolean;
};

export function GoalBreakdown({
  byCategory,
  byMonth,
  categories,
  isNarrowWidth,
}: GoalBreakdownProps) {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const format = useFormat();
  const locale = useLocale();

  const categoryNames = new Map(categories.map(cat => [cat.id, cat.name]));

  return (
    <View
      style={{
        flexDirection: isNarrowWidth ? 'column' : 'row',
        gap: 20,
      }}
    >
      <BreakdownPanel
        title={t('By category')}
        columns={[t('Category'), t('Amount')]}
        emptyText={t('No transactions in this range')}
      >
        {byCategory.map(row => (
          <BreakdownRow
            key={row.categoryId ?? 'uncategorized'}
            label={
              (row.categoryId && categoryNames.get(row.categoryId)) ||
              t('Uncategorized')
            }
            values={[format(row.amount, 'financial')]}
          />
        ))}
      </BreakdownPanel>
      <BreakdownPanel
        title={t('By month')}
        columns={[t('Month'), t('Amount'), t('Running total')]}
        emptyText={t('No transactions in this range')}
      >
        {byMonth.map(row => (
          <BreakdownRow
            key={row.month}
            label={monthUtils.format(row.month, 'MMMM yyyy', locale)}
            values={[
              format(row.amount, 'financial'),
              format(row.cumulative, 'financial'),
            ]}
          />
        ))}
      </BreakdownPanel>
    </View>
  );
}

type BreakdownPanelProps = {
  title: string;
  columns: string[];
  emptyText: string;
  children: ReactNode[];
};

function BreakdownPanel({
  title,
  columns,
  emptyText,
  children,
}: BreakdownPanelProps) {
  return (
    <View
      role="region"
      aria-label={title}
      style={{
        flex: 1,
        minWidth: 0,
        backgroundColor: theme.tableBackground,
        borderRadius: 4,
        padding: 15,
      }}
    >
      <Block style={{ ...styles.mediumText, fontWeight: 500, marginBottom: 10 }}>
        {title}
      </Block>
      <View
        style={{
          flexDirection: 'row',
          paddingBottom: 5,
          borderBottom: `1px solid ${theme.tableBorder}`,
          color: theme.pageTextSubdued,
        }}
      >
        {columns.map((column, index) => (
          <Block
            key={column}
            style={{
              flex: 1,
              textAlign: index === 0 ? 'left' : 'right',
            }}
          >
            {column}
          </Block>
        ))}
      </View>
      <View style={{ maxHeight: 240, overflowY: 'auto' }}>
        {children.length > 0 ? (
          children
        ) : (
          <Block
            style={{
              marginTop: 10,
              fontStyle: 'italic',
              color: theme.pageTextSubdued,
            }}
          >
            {emptyText}
          </Block>
        )}
      </View>
    </View>
  );
}

type BreakdownRowProps = {
  label: string;
  values: string[];
};

function BreakdownRow({ label, values }: BreakdownRowProps) {
  return (
    <View
      role="row"
      style={{
        flexDirection: 'row',
        paddingTop: 6,
        paddingBottom: 6,
        borderBottom: `1px solid ${theme.tableBorder}`,
      }}
    >
      <Block
        style={{
          flex: 1,
          overflow: 'hidden',
          textOverflow: 'ellipsis',
          whiteSpace: 'nowrap',
        }}
      >
        {label}
      </Block>
      {values.map((value, index) => (
        <Block key={index} style={{ flex: 1, textAlign: 'right' }}>
          <PrivacyFilter>
            <FinancialText>{value}</FinancialText>
          </PrivacyFilter>
        </Block>
      ))}
    </View>
  );
}

// Keeps <Trans> imported for i18n extraction consistency with other reports.
export const GOAL_BREAKDOWN_EMPTY = <Trans>No transactions</Trans>;

import { useEffect, useMemo, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import type { Ref } from 'react';
import { Trans, useTranslation } from 'react-i18next';
import { useParams } from 'react-router';

import { Block } from '@actual-app/components/block';
import { Button } from '@actual-app/components/button';
import { useResponsive } from '@actual-app/components/hooks/useResponsive';
import { styles } from '@actual-app/components/styles';
import { theme } from '@actual-app/components/theme';
import { View } from '@actual-app/components/view';
import { send } from '@actual-app/core/platform/client/connection';
import * as monthUtils from '@actual-app/core/shared/months';
import type { Query } from '@actual-app/core/shared/query';
import { ungroupTransactions } from '@actual-app/core/shared/transactions';
import type {
  GoalCardWidget,
  TimeFrame,
  TransactionEntity,
} from '@actual-app/core/types/models';
import type { TransObjectLiteral } from '@actual-app/core/types/util';
import { parseISO } from 'date-fns';

import { EditablePageHeaderTitle } from '#components/EditablePageHeaderTitle';
import { FinancialText } from '#components/FinancialText';
import { MobileBackButton } from '#components/mobile/MobileBackButton';
import { TransactionList as TransactionListMobile } from '#components/mobile/transactions/TransactionList';
import { MobilePageHeader, Page, PageHeader } from '#components/Page';
import { PrivacyFilter } from '#components/PrivacyFilter';
import { GoalBreakdown } from '#components/reports/GoalBreakdown';
import { GoalProgressBar } from '#components/reports/GoalProgressBar';
import { Header } from '#components/reports/Header';
import { LoadingIndicator } from '#components/reports/LoadingIndicator';
import { calculateTimeRange } from '#components/reports/reportRanges';
import {
  calculateGoalProgress,
  getGoalDateRange,
  goalSpreadsheet,
  makeGoalQuery,
} from '#components/reports/spreadsheets/goal-spreadsheet';
import { useReport } from '#components/reports/useReport';
import { fromDateRepr } from '#components/reports/util';
import type { TableHandleRef } from '#components/table';
import { TransactionList } from '#components/transactions/TransactionList';
import { AmountInput } from '#components/util/AmountInput';
import { useAccounts } from '#hooks/useAccounts';
import { SchedulesProvider } from '#hooks/useCachedSchedules';
import { useCategories } from '#hooks/useCategories';
import { useDashboardWidget } from '#hooks/useDashboardWidget';
import { useDateFormat } from '#hooks/useDateFormat';
import { DisplayPayeeProvider } from '#hooks/useDisplayPayee';
import { useFormat } from '#hooks/useFormat';
import { useLocale } from '#hooks/useLocale';
import { useNavigate } from '#hooks/useNavigate';
import { usePayees } from '#hooks/usePayees';
import { useRuleConditionFilters } from '#hooks/useRuleConditionFilters';
import { SelectedProviderWithItems } from '#hooks/useSelected';
import { SplitsExpandedProvider } from '#hooks/useSplitsExpanded';
import { useSyncedPref } from '#hooks/useSyncedPref';
import { useTransactions } from '#hooks/useTransactions';
import { addNotification } from '#notifications/notificationsSlice';
import { useDispatch } from '#redux';
import { useUpdateDashboardWidgetMutation } from '#reports/mutations';

export function GoalReport() {
  const params = useParams();
  const { data: widget, isLoading } = useDashboardWidget<GoalCardWidget>({
    id: params.id,
    type: 'goal-card',
  });

  if (isLoading) {
    return <LoadingIndicator />;
  }

  return <GoalReportInner widget={widget} />;
}

type GoalReportInnerProps = {
  widget?: GoalCardWidget;
};

function GoalReportInner({ widget }: GoalReportInnerProps) {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const locale = useLocale();
  const dispatch = useDispatch();
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const format = useFormat();
  const dateFormat = useDateFormat();
  const { isNarrowWidth } = useResponsive();

  const [start, setStart] = useState(
    monthUtils.dayFromDate(monthUtils.currentMonth()),
  );
  const [end, setEnd] = useState(monthUtils.currentDay());
  const [mode, setMode] = useState<TimeFrame['mode']>('full');
  const [targetAmount, setTargetAmount] = useState(
    widget?.meta?.targetAmount ?? 0,
  );
  const [earliestTransaction, setEarliestTransaction] = useState('');
  const [latestTransaction, setLatestTransaction] = useState('');
  const [allMonths, setAllMonths] = useState<
    Array<{ name: string; pretty: string }>
  >([]);

  const [_firstDayOfWeekIdx] = useSyncedPref('firstDayOfWeekIdx');
  const firstDayOfWeekIdx = _firstDayOfWeekIdx || '0';

  const {
    conditions,
    conditionsOp,
    onApply: onApplyFilter,
    onDelete: onDeleteFilter,
    onUpdate: onUpdateFilter,
    onConditionsOpChange,
  } = useRuleConditionFilters(
    widget?.meta?.conditions,
    widget?.meta?.conditionsOp,
  );

  const { data: accounts = [] } = useAccounts();
  const { data: payees = [] } = usePayees();
  const {
    data: { list: categories, grouped: categoryGroups } = {
      list: [],
      grouped: [],
    },
  } = useCategories();

  useEffect(() => {
    async function run() {
      const earliest = await send('get-earliest-transaction');
      const latest = await send('get-latest-transaction');
      setEarliestTransaction(
        earliest ? earliest.date : monthUtils.currentDay(),
      );
      setLatestTransaction(latest ? latest.date : monthUtils.currentDay());

      const currentMonth = monthUtils.currentMonth();
      let earliestMonth = earliest
        ? monthUtils.monthFromDate(parseISO(fromDateRepr(earliest.date)))
        : currentMonth;
      const latestTransactionMonth = latest
        ? monthUtils.monthFromDate(parseISO(fromDateRepr(latest.date)))
        : currentMonth;
      const latestMonth =
        latestTransactionMonth > currentMonth
          ? latestTransactionMonth
          : currentMonth;

      // Make sure the month selects are at least populated with a
      // year's worth of months.
      const yearAgo = monthUtils.subMonths(latestMonth, 12);
      if (earliestMonth > yearAgo) {
        earliestMonth = yearAgo;
      }

      setAllMonths(
        monthUtils
          .rangeInclusive(earliestMonth, latestMonth)
          .map(month => ({
            name: month,
            pretty: monthUtils.format(month, 'MMMM yyyy', locale),
          }))
          .reverse(),
      );
    }
    void run();
  }, [locale]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (latestTransaction) {
      const [initialStart, initialEnd, initialMode] = calculateTimeRange(
        widget?.meta?.timeFrame,
        {
          start: monthUtils.dayFromDate(monthUtils.currentMonth()),
          end: monthUtils.currentDay(),
          mode: 'full',
        },
        latestTransaction,
      );
      setStart(initialStart);
      setEnd(initialEnd);
      setMode(initialMode);
    }
  }, [latestTransaction, widget?.meta?.timeFrame]);

  const params = useMemo(
    () =>
      goalSpreadsheet(start, end, conditions, conditionsOp, {
        includeBreakdown: true,
      }),
    [start, end, conditions, conditionsOp],
  );
  const data = useReport('goal', params);

  const [sortField, setSortField] = useState('');
  const [ascDesc, setAscDesc] = useState<'asc' | 'desc'>('desc');
  const [query, setQuery] = useState<Query | undefined>(undefined);

  useEffect(() => {
    const { startDate, endDate } = getGoalDateRange(start, end);
    send('make-filters-from-conditions', {
      conditions: conditions.filter(cond => !cond.customName),
    })
      .then((response: { filters: unknown[] }) => {
        let transactionsQuery = makeGoalQuery(
          startDate,
          endDate,
          conditionsOp,
          response.filters,
        ).select('*');

        if (sortField) {
          transactionsQuery = transactionsQuery.orderBy({
            [getSortField(sortField)]: ascDesc,
          });
        }

        setQuery(transactionsQuery.options({ splits: 'grouped' }));
      })
      .catch((error: unknown) => {
        console.error('Error generating filters:', error);
      });
  }, [start, end, conditions, conditionsOp, sortField, ascDesc]);

  const {
    transactions: transactionsGrouped,
    fetchNextPage: loadMoreTransactions,
  } = useTransactions({ query });
  const allTransactions = useMemo(
    () => ungroupTransactions(transactionsGrouped as TransactionEntity[]),
    [transactionsGrouped],
  );

  const table = useRef<TableHandleRef<TransactionEntity>>(null);
  const updateDashboardWidgetMutation = useUpdateDashboardWidgetMutation();

  const title = widget?.meta?.name || t('Personal goal');
  const currentAmount = data?.total ?? 0;
  const progressPercent = calculateGoalProgress(currentAmount, targetAmount);
  const remainingAmount = Math.max(targetAmount - currentAmount, 0);

  function notifyMissingWidget() {
    dispatch(
      addNotification({
        notification: {
          type: 'error',
          message: t('Cannot save: No widget available.'),
        },
      }),
    );
  }

  const onSaveWidgetName = async (newName: string) => {
    if (!widget) {
      notifyMissingWidget();
      return;
    }

    const name = newName || t('Personal goal');
    updateDashboardWidgetMutation.mutate({
      widget: {
        id: widget.id,
        meta: {
          ...(widget.meta ?? {}),
          name,
        },
      },
    });
  };

  function onSaveWidget() {
    if (!widget) {
      notifyMissingWidget();
      return;
    }

    updateDashboardWidgetMutation.mutate(
      {
        widget: {
          id: widget.id,
          meta: {
            ...(widget.meta ?? {}),
            targetAmount,
            conditions,
            conditionsOp,
            timeFrame: { start, end, mode },
          },
        },
      },
      {
        onSuccess: () => {
          dispatch(
            addNotification({
              notification: {
                type: 'message',
                message: t('Dashboard widget successfully saved.'),
              },
            }),
          );
        },
        onError: error => {
          dispatch(
            addNotification({
              notification: {
                type: 'error',
                message: t('Failed to save dashboard widget.'),
              },
            }),
          );
          console.error('Error saving widget:', error);
        },
      },
    );
  }

  function onChangeDates(
    newStart: string,
    newEnd: string,
    newMode: TimeFrame['mode'],
  ) {
    setStart(newStart);
    setEnd(newEnd);
    setMode(newMode);
  }

  function onSort(headerClicked: string, newAscDesc: 'asc' | 'desc') {
    if (headerClicked === sortField) {
      setAscDesc(newAscDesc);
    } else {
      setSortField(headerClicked);
      setAscDesc('desc');
    }
  }

  return (
    <Page
      header={
        isNarrowWidth ? (
          <MobilePageHeader
            title={title}
            leftContent={
              <MobileBackButton onPress={() => navigate('/reports')} />
            }
          />
        ) : (
          <PageHeader
            title={
              widget ? (
                <EditablePageHeaderTitle
                  title={title}
                  onSave={onSaveWidgetName}
                />
              ) : (
                title
              )
            }
          />
        )
      }
      padding={0}
    >
      <Header
        allMonths={allMonths}
        start={start}
        end={end}
        earliestTransaction={earliestTransaction}
        latestTransaction={latestTransaction}
        firstDayOfWeekIdx={firstDayOfWeekIdx}
        mode={mode}
        onChangeDates={onChangeDates}
        filters={conditions}
        onApply={onApplyFilter}
        onUpdateFilter={onUpdateFilter}
        onDeleteFilter={onDeleteFilter}
        conditionsOp={conditionsOp}
        onConditionsOpChange={onConditionsOpChange}
        show1Month
      >
        {widget && (
          <Button variant="primary" onPress={onSaveWidget}>
            <Trans>Save widget</Trans>
          </Button>
        )}
      </Header>

      <View
        style={{
          flexShrink: 0,
          padding: 20,
          paddingTop: 0,
          gap: 20,
          backgroundColor: theme.pageBackground,
        }}
      >
        <View
          style={{
            flexDirection: isNarrowWidth ? 'column' : 'row',
            alignItems: isNarrowWidth ? 'stretch' : 'flex-end',
            gap: 20,
          }}
        >
          <View style={{ flex: 1 }}>
            <Block
              style={{ ...styles.largeText, fontWeight: 500, marginBottom: 5 }}
            >
              <PrivacyFilter>
                <FinancialText>{format(currentAmount, 'financial')}</FinancialText>
              </PrivacyFilter>
            </Block>
            <Block style={{ color: theme.pageTextSubdued }}>
              <PrivacyFilter>
                {remainingAmount > 0 ? (
                  <Trans>
                    <FinancialText>
                      {
                        {
                          remaining: format(remainingAmount, 'financial'),
                        } as TransObjectLiteral
                      }
                    </FinancialText>{' '}
                    to go across{' '}
                    {{ count: data?.count ?? 0 } as TransObjectLiteral}{' '}
                    matching transactions
                  </Trans>
                ) : (
                  <Trans>
                    Goal reached across{' '}
                    {{ count: data?.count ?? 0 } as TransObjectLiteral}{' '}
                    matching transactions
                  </Trans>
                )}
              </PrivacyFilter>
            </Block>
          </View>
          <View>
            <label
              htmlFor="goal-target-amount"
              style={{
                fontSize: 13,
                color: theme.pageTextSubdued,
                marginBottom: 5,
              }}
            >
              <Trans>Target amount</Trans>
            </label>
            <AmountInput
              id="goal-target-amount"
              value={targetAmount}
              sign="+"
              onUpdate={setTargetAmount}
              style={{ width: 180 }}
            />
          </View>
        </View>

        <GoalProgressBar percent={progressPercent} height={16} />

        {data && (
          <GoalBreakdown
            byCategory={data.byCategory}
            byMonth={data.byMonth}
            categories={categories}
            isNarrowWidth={isNarrowWidth}
          />
        )}

        <Block style={{ ...styles.mediumText, fontWeight: 500 }}>
          <Trans>Matching transactions</Trans>
        </Block>
      </View>

      <SelectedProviderWithItems
        name="transactions"
        items={[]}
        fetchAllIds={async () => []}
        registerDispatch={() => {}}
        selectAllFilter={(item: TransactionEntity) =>
          !item._unmatched && !item.is_parent
        }
      >
        <SchedulesProvider query={undefined}>
          <View
            style={{
              width: '100%',
              flexGrow: 1,
              minHeight: 300,
              overflow: isNarrowWidth ? 'auto' : 'hidden',
            }}
            // TODO: make TableHandleRef conform to HTMLDivEle
            ref={table as unknown as Ref<HTMLDivElement>}
          >
            {!isNarrowWidth ? (
              <SplitsExpandedProvider initialMode="collapse">
                <TransactionList
                  tableRef={table}
                  account={undefined}
                  transactions={transactionsGrouped}
                  allTransactions={allTransactions}
                  loadMoreTransactions={loadMoreTransactions}
                  accounts={accounts}
                  category={undefined}
                  categoryGroups={categoryGroups}
                  payees={payees}
                  balances={null}
                  showBalances={false}
                  showReconciled
                  showCleared={false}
                  showAccount
                  isAdding={false}
                  isNew={() => false}
                  isMatched={() => false}
                  dateFormat={dateFormat}
                  hideFraction={false}
                  renderEmpty={() => (
                    <View
                      style={{
                        color: theme.tableText,
                        marginTop: 20,
                        textAlign: 'center',
                        fontStyle: 'italic',
                      }}
                    >
                      <Trans>No transactions</Trans>
                    </View>
                  )}
                  onSort={onSort}
                  sortField={sortField}
                  ascDesc={ascDesc}
                  onChange={() => {}}
                  onRefetch={() => {}}
                  onCloseAddTransaction={() => {}}
                  onCreatePayee={async () => null}
                  onApplyFilter={() => {}}
                  onBatchDelete={() => {}}
                  onBatchDuplicate={() => {}}
                  onBatchLinkSchedule={() => {}}
                  onBatchUnlinkSchedule={() => {}}
                  onCreateRule={() => {}}
                  onScheduleAction={() => {}}
                  onMakeAsNonSplitTransactions={() => {}}
                  showSelection={false}
                  allowSplitTransaction={false}
                  allowReorder={false}
                />
              </SplitsExpandedProvider>
            ) : (
              <DisplayPayeeProvider transactions={allTransactions}>
                <TransactionListMobile
                  isLoading={false}
                  onLoadMore={loadMoreTransactions}
                  transactions={allTransactions}
                  onOpenTransaction={transaction =>
                    void navigate(`/transactions/${transaction.id}`)
                  }
                  isLoadingMore={false}
                />
              </DisplayPayeeProvider>
            )}
          </View>
        </SchedulesProvider>
      </SelectedProviderWithItems>
    </Page>
  );
}

function getSortField(field: string) {
  switch (field) {
    case 'account':
      return 'account.name';
    case 'payee':
      return 'payee.name';
    case 'category':
      return 'category.name';
    case 'payment':
    case 'deposit':
      return 'amount';
    default:
      return field;
  }
}

1	// Minimal connection mock used by desktop-client component tests.
2	//
3	// This mirrors `@actual-app/core`'s test-only mock implementation so that
4	// `useSpreadsheet()` and other code paths can call `send()` and receive a
5	// promise with a stable shape.
6
7	type Listener = (args: unknown) => void;
8	type Handler = (args: unknown) => unknown | Promise<unknown>;
9
10	let listeners = new Map<string, Array<Listener>>();
11	let serverHandler:
12	  | null
13	  | ((msg: { name: string; args: unknown; catchErrors: boolean }) => unknown) =
14	  null;
15
16	export const initServer = (handlers: Record<string, Handler>) => {
17	  serverHandler = msg => {
18	    const { name, args, catchErrors } = msg;
19	    if (handlers[name]) {
20	      return Promise.resolve().then(() => {
21	        const promise = Promise.resolve(handlers[name](args));
22
23	        if (catchErrors) {
24	          return promise.then(
25	            data => ({ data }),
26	            error => ({ error }),
27	          );
28	        }
29
30	        return promise;
31	      });
32	    }
33	  };
34	};
35
36	export const clearServer = async () => {
37	  serverHandler = null;
38	  listeners = new Map();
39	};
40
41	export const serverPush = (name: string, args: unknown) => {
42	  void Promise.resolve().then(() => {
43	    const listens = listeners.get(name);
44	    if (listens) {
45	      listens.forEach(listener => {
46	        listener(args);
47	      });
48	    }
49	  });
50	};
51
52	export const send = async (
53	  name: string,
54	  args: unknown,
55	  { catchErrors = false } = {},
56	) => {
57	  if (serverHandler) {
58	    return serverHandler({ name, args, catchErrors });
59	  } else {
60	    throw new Error('`send` called with no mock server installed');
61	  }
62	};
63
64	export const sendCatch = (name: string, args: unknown) => {
65	  return send(name, args, { catchErrors: true });
66	};
67
68	export const listen = (name: string, cb: Listener) => {
69	  if (!listeners.get(name)) {
70	    listeners.set(name, []);
71	  }
72
73	  listeners.get(name)!.push(cb);
74
75	  return () => {
76	    const arr = listeners.get(name) ?? [];
77	    listeners.set(
78	      name,
79	      arr.filter(cb_ => cb_ !== cb),
80	    );
81	  };
82	};

import {
  clearServer,
  initServer,
} from '@actual-app/core/platform/client/connection';
import type { QueryState } from '@actual-app/core/shared/query';
import type { RuleConditionEntity } from '@actual-app/core/types/models';

import type { useSpreadsheet } from '#hooks/useSpreadsheet';

import {
  calculateGoalProgress,
  fillMonthContributions,
  getGoalDateRange,
  goalSpreadsheet,
  sortCategoryContributions,
} from './goal-spreadsheet';
import type { GoalData } from './goal-spreadsheet';

vi.mock(
  '@actual-app/core/platform/client/connection',
  () => import('#mocks/connection'),
);

// `monthUtils.currentDay()` is fixed to 2017-01-01 in tests.

afterEach(async () => {
  await clearServer();
});

describe('getGoalDateRange', () => {
  it('covers whole months for a range in the past', () => {
    expect(getGoalDateRange('2016-03-15', '2016-06-02')).toEqual({
      startDate: '2016-03-01',
      endDate: '2016-06-30',
    });
  });

  it('stops at today when the range ends in the current month', () => {
    expect(getGoalDateRange('2016-10-01', '2017-01-31')).toEqual({
      startDate: '2016-10-01',
      endDate: '2017-01-01',
    });
  });

  it('accepts month strings as well as days', () => {
    expect(getGoalDateRange('2016-02', '2016-02')).toEqual({
      startDate: '2016-02-01',
      endDate: '2016-02-29',
    });
  });
});

describe('calculateGoalProgress', () => {
  it.each([
    { label: 'partway to the goal', current: 2500, target: 10000, pct: 25 },
    { label: 'nothing saved yet', current: 0, target: 10000, pct: 0 },
    { label: 'goal reached exactly', current: 10000, target: 10000, pct: 100 },
    { label: 'rounding down', current: 1000, target: 3000, pct: 33 },
    { label: 'rounding up', current: 2000, target: 3000, pct: 67 },
    { label: 'goal exceeded', current: 15000, target: 10000, pct: 100 },
    { label: 'negative net total', current: -500, target: 10000, pct: 0 },
    { label: 'no target set', current: 500, target: 0, pct: 0 },
    { label: 'negative target', current: 500, target: -100, pct: 0 },
  ])('is $pct% when $label', ({ current, target, pct }) => {
    expect(calculateGoalProgress(current, target)).toBe(pct);
  });
});

describe('sortCategoryContributions', () => {
  it('orders categories by the size of their contribution in either direction', () => {
    expect(
      sortCategoryContributions([
        { category: 'cat-small', amount: 1000 },
        { category: 'cat-withdrawal', amount: -50000 },
        { category: 'cat-big', amount: 30000 },
      ]),
    ).toEqual([
      { categoryId: 'cat-withdrawal', amount: -50000 },
      { categoryId: 'cat-big', amount: 30000 },
      { categoryId: 'cat-small', amount: 1000 },
    ]);
  });

  it('keeps uncategorized money and drops categories that net to zero', () => {
    expect(
      sortCategoryContributions([
        { category: null, amount: 2000 },
        { category: 'cat-wash', amount: 0 },
      ]),
    ).toEqual([{ categoryId: null, amount: 2000 }]);
  });
});

describe('fillMonthContributions', () => {
  it('includes every month in the range with a running total', () => {
    expect(
      fillMonthContributions(
        [
          { date: '2016-09', amount: 10000 },
          { date: '2016-11', amount: -2500 },
          { date: '2016-12', amount: 5000 },
        ],
        '2016-09-01',
        '2016-12-31',
      ),
    ).toEqual([
      { month: '2016-09', amount: 10000, cumulative: 10000 },
      { month: '2016-10', amount: 0, cumulative: 10000 },
      { month: '2016-11', amount: -2500, cumulative: 7500 },
      { month: '2016-12', amount: 5000, cumulative: 12500 },
    ]);
  });

  it('returns zero months when there are no transactions', () => {
    expect(fillMonthContributions([], '2016-11-01', '2016-12-31')).toEqual([
      { month: '2016-11', amount: 0, cumulative: 0 },
      { month: '2016-12', amount: 0, cumulative: 0 },
    ]);
  });
});

describe('goalSpreadsheet', () => {
  const FILTERS = [{ category: { $eq: 'cat-savings' } }];
  const conditions: RuleConditionEntity[] = [
    { field: 'category', op: 'is', value: 'cat-savings' },
  ];

  function installServer() {
    const queries: QueryState[] = [];
    const makeFilters = vi.fn(async () => ({ filters: FILTERS }));

    initServer({
      'make-filters-from-conditions': makeFilters,
      query: async (args: unknown) => {
        const query = args as QueryState;
        queries.push(query);
        const [group] = query.groupExpressions;
        if (!group) {
          return { data: [{ amount: 42000, count: 3 }], dependencies: [] };
        }
        if (typeof group === 'object' && '$month' in group) {
          return {
            data: [
              { date: '2016-11', amount: 12000 },
              { date: '2016-12', amount: 30000 },
            ],
            dependencies: [],
          };
        }
        return {
          data: [
            { category: 'cat-savings', amount: 40000 },
            { category: null, amount: 2000 },
          ],
          dependencies: [],
        };
      },
    });

    return { queries, makeFilters };
  }

  async function run(getData: ReturnType<typeof goalSpreadsheet>) {
    const setData = vi.fn<(data: GoalData) => void>();
    await getData({} as ReturnType<typeof useSpreadsheet>, setData);
    expect(setData).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
    return setData.mock.calls[0][0];
  }

  it('sums the transactions matching the conditions over the time frame', async () => {
    const { queries, makeFilters } = installServer();

    const data = await run(
      goalSpreadsheet('2016-11-01', '2016-12-15', conditions, 'or'),
    );

    expect(makeFilters).toHaveBeenCalledWith({ conditions });
    expect(queries).toHaveLength(1);
    expect(queries[0].filterExpressions).toEqual([
      {
        $and: [
          { date: { $gte: '2016-11-01' } },
          { date: { $lte: '2016-12-31' } },
        ],
      },
      { $or: FILTERS },
    ]);
    expect(data).toEqual({
      total: 42000,
      count: 3,
      startDate: '2016-11-01',
      endDate: '2016-12-31',
      byCategory: [],
      byMonth: [],
    });
  });

  it('ignores custom-named conditions when building filters', async () => {
    const { makeFilters } = installServer();

    await run(
      goalSpreadsheet('2016-11-01', '2016-12-15', [
        ...conditions,
        {
          field: 'notes',
          op: 'contains',
          value: 'x',
          customName: 'Saved filter',
        },
      ]),
    );

    expect(makeFilters).toHaveBeenCalledWith({ conditions });
  });

  it('breaks the total down by category and month when asked', async () => {
    const { queries } = installServer();

    const data = await run(
      goalSpreadsheet('2016-11-01', '2016-12-15', conditions, 'and', {
        includeBreakdown: true,
      }),
    );

    expect(queries).toHaveLength(3);
    expect(data.total).toBe(42000);
    expect(data.byCategory).toEqual([
      { categoryId: 'cat-savings', amount: 40000 },
      { categoryId: null, amount: 2000 },
    ]);
    expect(data.byMonth).toEqual([
      { month: '2016-11', amount: 12000, cumulative: 12000 },
      { month: '2016-12', amount: 30000, cumulative: 42000 },
    ]);
  });

  it('treats an empty result as no progress', async () => {
    initServer({
      'make-filters-from-conditions': async () => ({ filters: [] }),
      query: async () => ({ data: [], dependencies: [] }),
    });

    const data = await run(goalSpreadsheet('2016-12-01', '2016-12-31'));

    expect(data.total).toBe(0);
    expect(data.count).toBe(0);
  });
});

import React from 'react';

import {
  clearServer,
  initServer,
} from '@actual-app/core/platform/client/connection';
import type { QueryState } from '@actual-app/core/shared/query';
import type {
  GoalCardWidget,
  RuleConditionEntity,
} from '@actual-app/core/types/models';
import { act, fireEvent, render, screen } from '@testing-library/react';
import userEvent from '@testing-library/user-event';

import type { ContextMenuItem } from '#contextmenu/types';
import { useNavigate } from '#hooks/useNavigate';
import { SpreadsheetProvider } from '#hooks/useSpreadsheet';
import { createTestAppStore, TestProviders } from '#mocks';

import { GoalCard } from './GoalCard';

vi.mock(
  '@actual-app/core/platform/client/connection',
  () => import('#mocks/connection'),
);
vi.mock('#hooks/useNavigate');
// jsdom has no IntersectionObserver; treat the card as always on screen so
// ReportCard renders its children.
vi.mock('#hooks/useIsInViewport', () => ({
  useIsInViewport: () => true,
}));

const WIDGET_ID = 'goal-widget-1';
const SAVINGS_FILTER = { category: { $eq: 'cat-savings' } };
const savingsConditions: RuleConditionEntity[] = [
  { field: 'category', op: 'is', value: 'cat-savings' },
];

type Meta = GoalCardWidget['meta'];

/**
 * A fake backend whose matching-transaction total can be changed per test.
 */
function installServer(initialTotal: number) {
  const server = {
    total: initialTotal,
    queries: [] as QueryState[],
    makeFilters: vi.fn(async () => ({ filters: [SAVINGS_FILTER] })),
  };

  initServer({
    'get-latest-transaction': async () => ({ date: '2016-12-20' }),
    'make-filters-from-conditions': server.makeFilters,
    query: async (args: unknown) => {
      server.queries.push(args as QueryState);
      return {
        data: [{ amount: server.total, count: 2 }],
        dependencies: [],
      };
    },
  });

  return server;
}

function GoalCardUnderTest({
  meta,
  isEditing = false,
  onMetaChange,
}: {
  meta?: Meta;
  isEditing?: boolean;
  onMetaChange: (newMeta: Meta) => void;
}) {
  return (
    <SpreadsheetProvider>
      <GoalCard
        widgetId={WIDGET_ID}
        isEditing={isEditing}
        meta={meta}
        onMetaChange={onMetaChange}
      />
    </SpreadsheetProvider>
  );
}

function renderGoalCard({
  meta,
  isEditing = false,
  onMetaChange = vi.fn(),
  store = createTestAppStore(),
}: {
  meta?: Meta;
  isEditing?: boolean;
  onMetaChange?: (newMeta: Meta) => void;
  store?: ReturnType<typeof createTestAppStore>;
} = {}) {
  const result = render(
    <TestProviders store={store}>
      <GoalCardUnderTest
        meta={meta}
        isEditing={isEditing}
        onMetaChange={onMetaChange}
      />
    </TestProviders>,
  );
  return { ...result, onMetaChange, store };
}

function getProgressFill(container: HTMLElement) {
  const track = container.querySelector('[aria-hidden="true"]');
  const fill = track?.firstElementChild;
  if (!(fill instanceof HTMLElement)) {
    throw new Error('Progress bar not found');
  }
  return fill;
}

describe('GoalCard', () => {
  const mockNavigate = vi.fn();

  beforeEach(() => {
    vi.clearAllMocks();
    vi.mocked(useNavigate).mockReturnValue(mockNavigate);
  });

  afterEach(async () => {
    await clearServer();
  });

  describe('name', () => {
    it('shows the goal name from meta', async () => {
      installServer(0);
      renderGoalCard({ meta: { name: 'Emergency fund' } });

      expect(
        screen.getByRole('heading', { name: 'Emergency fund' }),
      ).toBeInTheDocument();
      await screen.findByText('0%');
    });

    it('falls back to a default name when none is set', async () => {
      installServer(0);
      renderGoalCard({ meta: {} });

      expect(
        screen.getByRole('heading', { name: 'Personal goal' }),
      ).toBeInTheDocument();
      await screen.findByText('0%');
    });
  });

  describe('tracking progress from transactions', () => {
    it('shows the total of matching transactions against the target', async () => {
      installServer(250000);
      renderGoalCard({
        meta: { targetAmount: 1000000, conditions: savingsConditions },
      });

      expect(await screen.findByText('2,500.00')).toBeInTheDocument();
      expect(screen.getByText(/10,000\.00/)).toBeInTheDocument();
      expect(screen.getByText('25%')).toBeInTheDocument();
    });

    it("queries only the goal's conditions over its time frame", async () => {
      const server = installServer(0);
      renderGoalCard({
        meta: {
          targetAmount: 1000000,
          conditions: savingsConditions,
          conditionsOp: 'or',
          timeFrame: { start: '2016-06', end: '2016-08', mode: 'static' },
        },
      });

      await screen.findByText('0%');
      expect(server.makeFilters).toHaveBeenLastCalledWith({
        conditions: savingsConditions,
      });
      expect(server.queries.at(-1)?.filterExpressions).toEqual([
        {
          $and: [
            { date: { $gte: '2016-06-01' } },
            { date: { $lte: '2016-08-31' } },
          ],
        },
        { $or: [SAVINGS_FILTER] },
      ]);
    });

    it.each([
      { label: 'partway to the goal', total: 250000, expected: 25 },
      { label: 'the goal is exceeded', total: 1500000, expected: 100 },
      { label: 'the matching total is negative', total: -50000, expected: 0 },
    ])(
      'fills the bar to $expected% when $label',
      async ({ total, expected }) => {
        installServer(total);
        const { container } = renderGoalCard({
          meta: { targetAmount: 1000000 },
        });

        expect(await screen.findByText(`${expected}%`)).toBeInTheDocument();
        expect(getComputedStyle(getProgressFill(container)).width).toBe(
          `${expected}%`,
        );
      },
    );

    it('shows no progress when no target is set', async () => {
      installServer(50000);
      renderGoalCard({ meta: null });

      expect(await screen.findByText('500.00')).toBeInTheDocument();
      expect(screen.getByText('0%')).toBeInTheDocument();
    });

    it('recalculates when the goal conditions change', async () => {
      const server = installServer(100000);
      const store = createTestAppStore();
      const { rerender, container } = renderGoalCard({
        meta: { targetAmount: 1000000 },
        store,
      });
      expect(await screen.findByText('10%')).toBeInTheDocument();

      server.total = 600000;
      rerender(
        <TestProviders store={store}>
          <GoalCardUnderTest
            meta={{ targetAmount: 1000000, conditions: savingsConditions }}
            onMetaChange={vi.fn()}
          />
        </TestProviders>,
      );

      expect(await screen.findByText('60%')).toBeInTheDocument();
      expect(getComputedStyle(getProgressFill(container)).width).toBe('60%');
    });
  });

  describe('navigation', () => {
    it('opens the goal report for this widget when clicked', async () => {
      installServer(0);
      const user = userEvent.setup();
      renderGoalCard({ meta: { name: 'Vacation' } });

      await user.click(screen.getByRole('button'));

      expect(mockNavigate).toHaveBeenCalledWith(`/reports/goal/${WIDGET_ID}`, {
        state: { goBack: true },
      });

    it('does not navigate while the dashboard is being edited', async () => {

      const user = userEvent.setup();
      renderGoalCard({ meta: { name: 'Vacation' }, isEditing: true });
      await screen.findByText('0%');

      await user.click(screen.getByRole('heading', { name: 'Vacation' }));

      expect(mockNavigate).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    });
  });

  describe('renaming', () => {
    it('saves the new name and keeps the rest of the goal', async () => {
      installServer(0);
      const user = userEvent.setup();
      const meta: Meta = {
        name: 'Vacation',

      const { onMetaChange, store } = renderGoalCard({ meta });

      expect(onMetaChange).toHaveBeenCalledWith({
        name: 'Trip to Japan',
        targetAmount: 1000000,
        conditions: savingsConditions,
      });
    });

});

driver. Use it instead of rediscovering.

Pick the row closest to your project. Each example walks through
launch + first interaction; ignore any trailing "write the skill"
section - you're using the recipe, not authoring one.

| -------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------ |

| Web server / API           | background launch + `curl` smoke                     | [examples/server.md](examples/server.md)         |

## Drive it, don't just launch it

Launching with no interaction proves the entrypoint resolves. That's
not running the app - it's typechecking with extra steps. Drive it to

````text
1	# Example: Browser-driven web app
2
3	You have a dev server that serves HTML to a browser. An agent in a
4	headless container can't open a browser window - so "run the app" means
5	launching the dev server, driving a headless Chromium against it, and
6	producing a screenshot that proves the page rendered.
7
8	Don't write a browser driver. Use `chromium-cli`.
9
10	## Dev server
11
12	Find the dev command (`package.json` `scripts.dev`, `Makefile`,
13	README), start it in the background, and wait for it to actually serve:
14
15	```bash
16	npm run dev &   # or yarn dev, pnpm dev, make serve, ./dev.sh
17	timeout 30 bash -c 'until curl -sf http://localhost:3000 >/dev/null; do sleep 1; done'
18	```
19
20	Don't `sleep 5` - poll the port. Stop by killing the port's listener
21	-- `lsof -ti:3000 -sTCP:LISTEN | xargs -r kill` - before relaunching,
22	or the next run hits `EADDRINUSE`. (`$!` after `npm run dev &` is only
23	the npm wrapper; npm doesn't forward SIGTERM to the server it spawned,
24	so the port kill is what actually frees it.) Avoid `pkill -f` with a
25	broad pattern - it can match the agent's own command line and kill the
26	session.
27
28	## Drive
29
30	`chromium-cli` is a headless-Chromium REPL. Pipe a script to stdin:
31
32	```bash
33	chromium-cli --session app <<'EOF'
34	nav http://localhost:3000
35	wait-for text=Dashboard
36	screenshot
37	click button:has-text("New item")
38	fill input[name="title"] Smoke test
39	press Enter
40	wait-for text=Smoke test
41	screenshot
42	console --errors
43	EOF
44	```
45
46	Screenshots land in `chromium_cli/sessions/app/screenshots/` (latest
47	symlinked as `screenshot.png`). That's the whole loop: `nav` ->
48	`wait-for` the element you need -> act (`click` / `fill` / `type` /
49	`press`) -> `screenshot` -> `console --errors` to check nothing threw.
50	Full command reference: `chromium-cli` skill, or `help` at the prompt.
51
52	For iterative debugging, run it under tmux and `send-keys` one command
53	at a time - same commands, same session.
54
55	**If `chromium-cli` isn't available:** adapt
56	[electron.md](electron.md)'s REPL driver - the structure and commands
57	transfer, but it's `_electron`-specific:
58	import `{ chromium }` instead, launch with
59	`chromium.launch({ args: ['--no-sandbox'] })`, acquire the page via
60	`(await app.newContext()).newPage()` then `goto()` your dev URL, and
61	drop the Electron-only window introspection
62	(`.windows()`/`.firstWindow()`/the `windows` command).
63
64	## What to put in the skill
65
66	The project-specific bits only. `chromium-cli` handles the mechanics.
67
68	- **Dev command + port + stop.** The exact start line, any env vars it
69	  needs, and the `kill` to stop it.
70	- **Auth.** Whatever gets a logged-in session - a `set-cookie` line, a
71	  `fill`/`click` login sequence, or a helper script that does the API
72	  dance and emits the cookie.
73	- **One representative interaction.** Not the whole app - one path that
74	  proves it's running, ending in a screenshot.
75	- **App-specific gotchas.** Only the ones you actually hit.
76
77	## Gotchas that recur
78
79	- **React controlled inputs.** `eval el.value = '...'` doesn't fire
80	  React's onChange. Use `fill` / `type` - they go through Playwright's
81	  input pipeline.
82	- **Websockets / long-poll.** `wait-idle` never settles. `wait-for` the
83	  element you actually need.
84	- **Slow first paint.** Vite/Next compile routes on demand; the first
85	  `nav` can take 10s+. `wait-for` handles it; raw `sleep` doesn't.
86	- **`screenshot-element <sel>`** crops to one element - use it when the
87	  diff is in a specific component, not the whole page.
88	- **Check `console --errors` before declaring success.** A page can
89	  render its shell while every data fetch 500s.
90
````

import { createRequire } from 'node:module';
import path from 'node:path';

const require = createRequire('C:/Users/reese/SE/actual-budget/package.json');
const { chromium } = require('playwright');

const OUT = path.dirname(new URL(import.meta.url).pathname).replace(/^\//, '');
const BASE = 'http://localhost:3001';

const browser = await chromium.launch({ channel: 'msedge', headless: true });
const context = await browser.newContext({
  viewport: { width: 1400, height: 1000 },
});
const page = await context.newPage();

const errors = [];
page.on('console', msg => {
  if (msg.type() === 'error') errors.push(msg.text());
});
page.on('pageerror', err => errors.push(`pageerror: ${err.message}`));

async function shot(name) {
  const file = path.join(OUT, `${name}.png`);
  await page.screenshot({ path: file, fullPage: false });
  console.log('screenshot', file);
}

try {
  await page.goto(BASE);
  await page
    .getByRole('button', { name: /don.t use a server/i })
    .click({ timeout: 60000 });
  await page.getByRole('button', { name: /view demo/i }).click();
  // Wait for the budget to load.
  await page
    .getByText(/budget/i)
    .first()
    .waitFor({ timeout: 60000 });
  await page.waitForTimeout(3000);

  await page.goto(`${BASE}/reports`);
  await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Add new widget' }).click();
  await page.getByRole('menuitem', { name: 'Personal goal' }).click();
  const card = page.locator('button:has(h2:text-is("Personal goal"))');
  await card.waitFor({ timeout: 30000 });
  await page.waitForTimeout(1500);
  await shot('1-dashboard');

  await card.click();
  await page.waitForURL(/\/reports\/goal\/.+/, { timeout: 30000 });
  console.log('url', page.url());
  await page.getByText('By category').waitFor({ timeout: 30000 });
  await page.waitForTimeout(2000);
  await shot('2-goal-report');

  for (const text of [
    'Target amount',
    'By category',
    'By month',
    'Running total',
    'Matching transactions',
    'Save widget',
  ]) {
    console.log(
      'visible',
      JSON.stringify(text),
      await page.getByText(text, { exact: true }).first().isVisible(),
    );
  }

  // Set a target and confirm the progress updates.
  const target = page.locator('#goal-target-amount');
  await target.click();
  await target.fill('5000');
  await target.press('Enter');
  await page.waitForTimeout(1000);
  await shot('3-target-set');

  await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Save widget' }).click();
  await page.waitForTimeout(1500);

  // Back on the dashboard, the card should reflect the saved target.
  await page.goto(`${BASE}/reports`);
  await card.waitFor({ timeout: 30000 });
  await page.waitForTimeout(2000);
  await shot('4-dashboard-after-save');

  // Narrow (mobile) layout of the report.
  await page.setViewportSize({ width: 390, height: 844 });
  await page.goBack();
  await page.waitForTimeout(500);
  await page.goForward();
  await page.waitForTimeout(500);
} catch (err) {
  console.log('FAILED', err.message);
  await shot('failure');
} finally {
  console.log('console errors:', errors.length);
  for (const e of errors.slice(0, 20)) console.log('  ', e.slice(0, 300));
  await browser.close();
}

import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { Trans, useTranslation } from 'react-i18next';
import { useParams } from 'react-router';

import { Block } from '@actual-app/components/block';
import { Button } from '@actual-app/components/button';
import { useResponsive } from '@actual-app/components/hooks/useResponsive';
import { styles } from '@actual-app/components/styles';
import { theme } from '@actual-app/components/theme';
import { View } from '@actual-app/components/view';
import { send } from '@actual-app/core/platform/client/connection';
import * as monthUtils from '@actual-app/core/shared/months';
import type { GoalCardWidget, TimeFrame } from '@actual-app/core/types/models';
import type { TransObjectLiteral } from '@actual-app/core/types/util';

import { EditablePageHeaderTitle } from '#components/EditablePageHeaderTitle';
import { FinancialText } from '#components/FinancialText';
import { MobileBackButton } from '#components/mobile/MobileBackButton';
import { MobilePageHeader, Page, PageHeader } from '#components/Page';
import { PrivacyFilter } from '#components/PrivacyFilter';
import { DateRange } from '#components/reports/DateRange';
import { Header } from '#components/reports/Header';
import { LoadingIndicator } from '#components/reports/LoadingIndicator';
import { calculateTimeRange } from '#components/reports/reportRanges';
import { useDashboardWidget } from '#hooks/useDashboardWidget';
import { useFormat } from '#hooks/useFormat';
import { useLocale } from '#hooks/useLocale';
import { useNavigate } from '#hooks/useNavigate';
import { useRuleConditionFilters } from '#hooks/useRuleConditionFilters';
import { useSyncedPref } from '#hooks/useSyncedPref';
import { addNotification } from '#notifications/notificationsSlice';
import { useDispatch } from '#redux';
import { useUpdateDashboardWidgetMutation } from '#reports/mutations';

export function GoalReport() {
  const params = useParams();
  const { data: widget, isLoading } = useDashboardWidget<GoalCardWidget>({
    id: params.id,
    type: 'goal-card',
  });

  if (isLoading) {
    return <LoadingIndicator />;
  }

  return <GoalReportInner widget={widget} />;
}

type GoalReportInnerProps = {
  widget?: GoalCardWidget;
};

function GoalReportInner({ widget }: GoalReportInnerProps) {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const locale = useLocale();
  const dispatch = useDispatch();
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const format = useFormat();
  const { isNarrowWidth } = useResponsive();

  const [start, setStart] = useState(
    monthUtils.dayFromDate(monthUtils.currentMonth()),
  );
  const [end, setEnd] = useState(monthUtils.currentDay());
  const [mode, setMode] = useState<TimeFrame['mode']>('full');
  const [earliestTransaction, setEarliestTransaction] = useState('');
  const [latestTransaction, setLatestTransaction] = useState('');
  const [allMonths, setAllMonths] = useState<
    Array<{ name: string; pretty: string }>
  >([]);

  const [_firstDayOfWeekIdx] = useSyncedPref('firstDayOfWeekIdx');
  const firstDayOfWeekIdx = _firstDayOfWeekIdx || '0';

  const {
    conditions,
    conditionsOp,
    onApply: onApplyFilter,
    onDelete: onDeleteFilter,
    onUpdate: onUpdateFilter,
    onConditionsOpChange,
  } = useRuleConditionFilters(
    widget?.meta?.conditions,
    widget?.meta?.conditionsOp,
  );

  // The date picker needs the range of months that have transactions.
  useEffect(() => {
    async function run() {
      const earliest = await send('get-earliest-transaction');
      const latest = await send('get-latest-transaction');
      const earliestDay = earliest ? earliest.date : monthUtils.currentDay();
      const latestDay = latest ? latest.date : monthUtils.currentDay();
      setEarliestTransaction(earliestDay);
      setLatestTransaction(latestDay);

      const currentMonth = monthUtils.currentMonth();
      const latestTransactionMonth = monthUtils.monthFromDate(latestDay);
      const latestMonth =
        latestTransactionMonth > currentMonth
          ? latestTransactionMonth
          : currentMonth;
      // Show at least a year's worth of months in the selects.
      const yearAgo = monthUtils.subMonths(latestMonth, 12);
      const earliestMonth = monthUtils.monthFromDate(earliestDay);

      setAllMonths(
        monthUtils
          .rangeInclusive(
            earliestMonth < yearAgo ? earliestMonth : yearAgo,
            latestMonth,
          )
          .map(month => ({
            name: month,
            pretty: monthUtils.format(month, 'MMMM yyyy', locale),
          }))
          .reverse(),
      );
    }
    void run();
  }, [locale]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (latestTransaction) {
      const [initialStart, initialEnd, initialMode] = calculateTimeRange(
        widget?.meta?.timeFrame,
        {
          start: monthUtils.dayFromDate(monthUtils.currentMonth()),
          end: monthUtils.currentDay(),
          mode: 'full',
        },
        latestTransaction,
      );
      setStart(initialStart);
      setEnd(initialEnd);
      setMode(initialMode);
    }
  }, [latestTransaction, widget?.meta?.timeFrame]);

  const updateDashboardWidgetMutation = useUpdateDashboardWidgetMutation();

  const title = widget?.meta?.name || t('Personal goal');
  const currentAmount = widget?.meta?.currentAmount ?? 0;
  const targetAmount = widget?.meta?.targetAmount ?? 0;
  const progress =
    targetAmount > 0
      ? Math.min(Math.max(currentAmount / targetAmount, 0), 1)
      : 0;
  const progressPercent = Math.round(progress * 100);

  function notifyMissingWidget() {
    dispatch(
      addNotification({
        notification: {
          type: 'error',
          message: t('Cannot save: No widget available.'),
        },
      }),
    );
  }

  const onSaveWidgetName = async (newName: string) => {
    if (!widget) {
      notifyMissingWidget();
      return;
    }

    const name = newName || t('Personal goal');
    updateDashboardWidgetMutation.mutate({
      widget: {
        id: widget.id,
        meta: {
          ...(widget.meta ?? {}),
          name,
        },
      },
    });
  };

  function onSaveWidget() {
    if (!widget) {
      notifyMissingWidget();
      return;
    }

    updateDashboardWidgetMutation.mutate(
      {
        widget: {
          id: widget.id,
          meta: {
            ...(widget.meta ?? {}),
            conditions,
            conditionsOp,
            timeFrame: { start, end, mode },
          },
        },
      },
      {
        onSuccess: () => {
          dispatch(
            addNotification({
              notification: {
                type: 'message',
                message: t('Dashboard widget successfully saved.'),
              },
            }),
          );
        },
      },
    );
  }

  function onChangeDates(
    newStart: string,
    newEnd: string,
    newMode: TimeFrame['mode'],
  ) {
    setStart(newStart);
    setEnd(newEnd);
    setMode(newMode);
  }

  return (
    <Page
      header={
        isNarrowWidth ? (
          <MobilePageHeader
            title={title}
            leftContent={
              <MobileBackButton onPress={() => navigate('/reports')} />
            }
          />
        ) : (
          <PageHeader
            title={
              widget ? (
                <EditablePageHeaderTitle
                  title={title}
                  onSave={onSaveWidgetName}
                />
              ) : (
                title
              )
            }
          />
        )
      }
      padding={0}
    >
      <Header
        allMonths={allMonths}
        start={start}
        end={end}
        earliestTransaction={earliestTransaction}
        latestTransaction={latestTransaction}
        firstDayOfWeekIdx={firstDayOfWeekIdx}
        mode={mode}
        onChangeDates={onChangeDates}
        filters={conditions}
        onApply={onApplyFilter}
        onUpdateFilter={onUpdateFilter}
        onDeleteFilter={onDeleteFilter}
        conditionsOp={conditionsOp}
        onConditionsOpChange={onConditionsOpChange}
        show1Month
      >
        {widget && (
          <Button variant="primary" onPress={onSaveWidget}>
            <Trans>Save widget</Trans>
          </Button>
        )}
      </Header>

      <View
        style={{
          flex: 1,
          padding: 20,
          paddingTop: 0,
          gap: 20,
          backgroundColor: theme.pageBackground,
        }}
      >
        <View>
          <Block
            style={{ ...styles.largeText, fontWeight: 500, marginBottom: 5 }}
          >
            <PrivacyFilter>
              <FinancialText>{format(currentAmount, 'financial')}</FinancialText>
            </PrivacyFilter>
          </Block>
          <Block style={{ color: theme.pageTextSubdued }}>
            <PrivacyFilter>
              <Trans>
                of{' '}
                <FinancialText>
                  {
                    {
                      targetAmount: format(targetAmount, 'financial'),
                    } as TransObjectLiteral
                  }
                </FinancialText>
              </Trans>
            </PrivacyFilter>
          </Block>
        </View>

        <View>
          <View
            aria-hidden
            style={{
              height: 16,
              borderRadius: 8,
              backgroundColor: theme.pillBackground,
              overflow: 'hidden',
            }}
          >
            <View
              style={{
                width: `${progressPercent}%`,
                height: '100%',
                backgroundColor: theme.reportsGreen,
              }}
            />
          </View>
          <Block
            style={{
              ...styles.tnum,
              marginTop: 5,
              textAlign: 'right',
              color: theme.pageTextSubdued,
            }}
          >
            {progressPercent}%
          </Block>
        </View>

        {/* Placeholder: will list the transactions matching `conditions`
            over the selected time frame. */}
        <View
          style={{
            flex: 1,
            minHeight: 200,
            padding: 20,
            borderRadius: 4,
            backgroundColor: theme.tableBackground,
            gap: 10,
          }}
        >
          <Block style={{ ...styles.mediumText, fontWeight: 500 }}>
            <Trans>Matching transactions</Trans>
          </Block>
          <DateRange start={start} end={end} />
          <Block style={{ color: theme.pageTextSubdued, fontStyle: 'italic' }}>
            <Trans>
              Transactions that match this goal’s filters during the selected
              time frame will appear here.
            </Trans>
          </Block>
        </View>
      </View>
    </Page>
  );
}

You can now set a goal amount from both the dashboard card and the Goal report page. Typecheck and lint pass, and all 19 card tests pass, including 3 new ones. I haven't checked either change in a browser.

**On the card** ([GoalCard.tsx](packages/desktop-client/src/components/reports/reports/GoalCard.tsx)):

- Right-clicking the card, or using its ⋯ menu while editing the dashboard, now shows **Set goal** alongside Rename, Remove and Copy. I followed the way the Text widget adds its own menu items.
- Choosing it replaces "of {target}" with a **Goal amount** input. Pressing Enter or clicking away saves the new target and keeps the name and current amount.
- Clicking the card doesn't open the report while the input is showing.

**On the report page** ([GoalReport.tsx](packages/desktop-client/src/components/reports/reports/GoalReport.tsx)):

- A **Goal amount** input sits next to the summary, and the progress bar and percentage update as you change it.
- The new target is saved to the widget by the existing **Save widget** button, together with the filters and time frame.

The new tests check that **Set goal** saves the amount and keeps the rest of the goal, that it works on a new card with no target yet, and that clicking the input doesn't open the report.

Progress still comes from the saved `currentAmount`, and nothing sets that value yet. Every new goal starts at 0%, so a goal shows no progress until something fills in `currentAmount`.

None of these changes are staged yet; the staged copies are still the earlier versions.

_**Agent (claude-opus-5-5 2026-10-04 17:05:31Z)**_

**I'd use a tag.** Tags fit deposit-driven goals much better, and the goal widget can already filter by tag.

**Why a category is a poor fit**

- **Most goal deposits have no category.** Moving money from checking to savings between two on-budget accounts is a transfer, and Actual doesn't put a category on those. A category-linked goal would miss the most common way people save.
- **It interferes with the budget.** A transaction has only one category, which already decides which budget envelope it counts against. Using a category to mean "this goes toward my vacation goal" means either changing how users budget or creating a special category for each goal.
- **Income has its own category.** A paycheck that's partly meant for a goal is already categorized as income, so you can't also give it a goal category.

**Why a tag fits**

- **Tags work on any transaction.** You can tag deposits, transfers, income and spending, and a transaction can carry several tags (`#vacation #japan`), so the budget isn't affected.
- **No new matching code is needed.** Tags live in the notes as `#vacation`, and Actual already filters on them: [rules.ts:38](packages/loot-core/src/shared/rules.ts#L38) defines a `notes` / `hasTags` condition, and loot-core already has tests for querying transactions with it. The goal widget already stores filter `conditions`, so a linked tag could be saved as `{ field: 'notes', op: 'hasTags', value: '#vacation' }`.
- **Tags are managed.** They have their own entity ([tags.ts](packages/loot-core/src/types/models/tags.ts)), with colours and a management page, so a goal could offer a dropdown of existing tags. Rules can also add the tag automatically, for example to every transfer into a specific savings account.

**One catch:** a transfer creates two transactions, one in each account. If both sides get the tag, the deposit and withdrawal cancel out to $0. The fix is to tag only the side going into savings, or to also filter the goal by that account.

**A category can still be a later option** for people who track a goal through a category's budget balance. That works differently, though: it reads the envelope balance, not tagged transactions.

To build the tag link I'd add a **Linked tag** dropdown to the card's **Set goal** input and to the report page, saved as that condition on the goal. One thing to decide first: linking only does something visible if progress is calculated from the tagged transactions. That brings back the live calculation you asked me to remove earlier. Should progress be calculated from tagged transactions now, or should I only store which tag is linked for now?

21	export function filterTags<T extends TagEntity>(
22	  tags: T[],
23	  filterStr: string,
24	): T[] {

34	export function useFilteredTags(
35	  filterStr: string,
36	  requireHashInFilter?: boolean,
37	) {
38	  const { data: tags, ...rest } = useTags();
39	  const filteredTags = useMemo(() => {
40	    if (!filterStr || !tags) return [];
41	    if (requireHashInFilter && !filterStr.startsWith('#')) return [];
42	    return new Fzf(tags, {
43	      selector: tag => tag.tag,
44	      limit: 100,
45	      tiebreakers: [byLengthAsc, byStartAsc],
46	      casing: 'case-insensitive',
47	    })
48	      .find(filterStr.replace(/^#/, ''))
49	      .map(item => item.item);
50	  }, [tags, filterStr, requireHashInFilter]);
51	  return {
52	    data: filteredTags,

54	  };

import type { CSSProperties } from 'react';
import { useTranslation } from 'react-i18next';

import { Select } from '@actual-app/components/select';

import { useTags } from '#hooks/useTags';

const NO_TAG = '';

type GoalTagSelectProps = {
  id?: string;
  value?: string;
  onChange: (tag: string | undefined) => void;
  style?: CSSProperties;
};

export function GoalTagSelect({
  id,
  value,
  onChange,
  style,
}: GoalTagSelectProps) {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const { data: tags = [] } = useTags();

  const tagNames = tags.map(tag => tag.tag);
  // Keep showing a linked tag even if it was since hidden or deleted.
  if (value && !tagNames.includes(value)) {
    tagNames.push(value);
  }

  return (
    <Select
      id={id}
      value={value ?? NO_TAG}
      options={[
        [NO_TAG, t('No tag')],
        ...tagNames.map(tag => [tag, `#${tag}`] as const),
      ]}
      onChange={newValue => onChange(newValue === NO_TAG ? undefined : newValue)}
      style={style}
    />
  );
}

import { useState } from 'react';
import { Trans } from 'react-i18next';

import { Button } from '@actual-app/components/button';
import { theme } from '@actual-app/components/theme';
import { View } from '@actual-app/components/view';

import { NON_DRAGGABLE_AREA_CLASS_NAME } from '#components/reports/constants';
import { GoalTagSelect } from '#components/reports/GoalTagSelect';
import { AmountInput } from '#components/util/AmountInput';

type GoalSettings = {
  targetAmount: number;
  linkedTag?: string;
};

type GoalSettingsEditorProps = {
  idPrefix: string;
  initialSettings: GoalSettings;
  onSave: (settings: GoalSettings) => void;
  onCancel: () => void;
};

export function GoalSettingsEditor({
  idPrefix,
  initialSettings,
  onSave,
  onCancel,
}: GoalSettingsEditorProps) {
  const [targetAmount, setTargetAmount] = useState(
    initialSettings.targetAmount,
  );
  const [linkedTag, setLinkedTag] = useState(initialSettings.linkedTag);

  const amountId = `${idPrefix}-amount`;
  const tagId = `${idPrefix}-tag`;
  const labelStyle = { color: theme.pageTextSubdued, marginBottom: 3 };

  return (
    <View
      className={NON_DRAGGABLE_AREA_CLASS_NAME}
      style={{ flexDirection: 'row', flexWrap: 'wrap', alignItems: 'flex-end', gap: 10 }}
    >
      <View>
        <label htmlFor={amountId} style={labelStyle}>
          <Trans>Goal amount</Trans>
        </label>
        <AmountInput
          id={amountId}
          value={targetAmount}
          sign="+"
          focused
          style={{ width: 140 }}
          onUpdate={setTargetAmount}
          onEnter={(_, amount) =>
            onSave({ targetAmount: amount ?? targetAmount, linkedTag })
          }
        />
      </View>
      <View>
        <label htmlFor={tagId} style={labelStyle}>
          <Trans>Linked tag</Trans>
        </label>
        <GoalTagSelect
          id={tagId}
          value={linkedTag}
          onChange={setLinkedTag}
          style={{ minWidth: 120 }}
        />
      </View>
      <View style={{ flexDirection: 'row', gap: 5 }}>
        <Button onPress={onCancel}>
          <Trans>Cancel</Trans>
        </Button>
        <Button
          variant="primary"
          onPress={() => onSave({ targetAmount, linkedTag })}
        >
          <Trans>Save</Trans>
        </Button>
      </View>
    </View>
  );
}

```
