_**Agent (claude-opus-5-5 2026-10-04 17:51:23Z)**_

You can now link a tag to a goal from both the dashboard card and the Goal report page. Progress still uses the saved `currentAmount`; the tag is only stored for now. All 24 card tests pass, and typecheck and lint pass. I haven't checked either change in a browser.

**On the card**

- **Set goal** now opens a small editor in place of the progress bar. It has the **Goal amount** input, a **Linked tag** dropdown listing your existing tags plus "No tag", and Cancel and Save buttons.
- Enter in the amount field also saves. Both settings are saved together, so one can't overwrite the other.
- A linked tag shows under the goal name as a coloured `#vacation` tag, using the same colours as on transactions.

**On the report page**

- **Linked tag** sits next to **Goal amount**, and both are saved with **Save widget**.
- The "Matching transactions" placeholder now reads "Transactions tagged #vacation during the selected time frame will appear here." With no tag linked, it says "Link a tag to this goal to choose which transactions count toward it."

**Where it's stored:** I added a separate `linkedTag` field on the goal widget ([dashboard.ts](packages/loot-core/src/types/models/dashboard.ts)), holding the tag name without the `#`. This is different from what I suggested last time, which was storing it as a filter condition. A separate field can't be removed by accident while editing the report's filters, and it's easy to read back for the dropdown and the card. When you add the calculation later, it can add a `notes` / `hasTags` condition built from `linkedTag`. Choosing "No tag" removes the field rather than saving an empty value.

**New files:**

- [GoalTagSelect.tsx](packages/desktop-client/src/components/reports/GoalTagSelect.tsx) is the tag dropdown used by both the card and the report. If a linked tag is later hidden or deleted, it still shows.
- [GoalSettingsEditor.tsx](packages/desktop-client/src/components/reports/GoalSettingsEditor.tsx) is the card's editor.

**New tests** (5, in [GoalCard.test.tsx](packages/desktop-client/src/components/reports/reports/GoalCard.test.tsx)):

- Cancel saves nothing.
- The linked tag appears on the card, and nothing appears when no tag is linked.
- Choosing a tag and an amount saves both in one update.
- Choosing "No tag" removes the link.

Nothing new is staged yet. The staged copies of `GoalCard.tsx`, `GoalReport.tsx` and the test file are still the earlier versions.

# Add GoalCardWidget type

## Context

A new "goal" dashboard card needs a widget type definition in
[dashboard.ts](packages/loot-core/src/types/models/dashboard.ts), following the

registered in the `SpecializedWidget` union.

`packages/loot-core/src/types/models/dashboard.ts`

```ts
export type GoalCardWidget = AbstractWidget<
  'goal-card',
  {
    name?: string;
    targetAmount?: number; // integer amount (cents), like other Actual amounts
    conditions?: RuleConditionEntity[];
    conditionsOp?: 'and' | 'or';
    timeFrame?: TimeFrame;
  } | null
>;
```

- `yarn lint:fix`.

```typescript
import React, { useState } from 'react';
import { useTranslation } from 'react-i18next';

import { Block } from '@actual-app/components/block';
import { styles } from '@actual-app/components/styles';
import { View } from '@actual-app/components/view';
import type { GoalCardWidget } from '@actual-app/core/types/models';

import { FinancialText } from '#components/FinancialText';
import { PrivacyFilter } from '#components/PrivacyFilter';
import { ReportCard } from '#components/reports/ReportCard';
import { ReportCardName } from '#components/reports/ReportCardName';
import { useFormat } from '#hooks/useFormat';

type GoalCardProps = {
  widgetId: string;
  isEditing?: boolean;
  meta?: GoalCardWidget['meta'];
  onMetaChange: (newMeta: GoalCardWidget['meta']) => void;
};

export function GoalCard({
  widgetId,
  isEditing,
  meta = {},
  onMetaChange,
}: GoalCardProps) {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const format = useFormat();
  const [nameMenuOpen, setNameMenuOpen] = useState(false);

  return (
    <ReportCard
      widgetId={widgetId}
      isEditing={isEditing}
      disableClick={nameMenuOpen}
      onRename={() => setNameMenuOpen(true)}
    >
      <View style={{ flex: 1, overflow: 'hidden' }}>
        <View style={{ flexGrow: 0, flexShrink: 0, padding: 20 }}>
          <ReportCardName
            name={meta?.name || t('Personal goal')}
            isEditing={nameMenuOpen}
            onChange={newName => {
              onMetaChange({
                ...meta,
                name: newName,
              });
              setNameMenuOpen(false);
            }}
            onClose={() => setNameMenuOpen(false)}
          />
        </View>
        <View
          style={{
            justifyContent: 'center',
            alignItems: 'center',
            flexGrow: 1,
            flexShrink: 1,
          }}
        >
          <Block style={{ ...styles.mediumText, fontWeight: 500 }}>
            <PrivacyFilter>
              <FinancialText>
                {format(meta?.targetAmount ?? 0, 'financial')}
              </FinancialText>
            </PrivacyFilter>
          </Block>
        </View>
      </View>
    </ReportCard>
  );
}

```

// Placeholder values until the goal total is calculated from transactions
const PLACEHOLDER_CURRENT_TOTAL = 125000;
const PLACEHOLDER_TARGET_AMOUNT = 500000;

type GoalCardProps = {
  widgetId: string;
  isEditing?: boolean;
  meta?: GoalCardWidget['meta'];
  onMetaChange: (newMeta: GoalCardWidget['meta']) => void;
};

export function GoalCard({
  widgetId,
  isEditing,
  meta = {},
  onMetaChange,
}: GoalCardProps) {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const format = useFormat();

  const [nameMenuOpen, setNameMenuOpen] = useState(false);
  const [isCardHovered, setIsCardHovered] = useState(false);

  const currentTotal = PLACEHOLDER_CURRENT_TOTAL;
  const targetAmount = meta?.targetAmount || PLACEHOLDER_TARGET_AMOUNT;
  const progress = Math.min(Math.max(currentTotal / targetAmount, 0), 1);

  return (

      widgetId={widgetId}
      isEditing={isEditing}
      disableClick={nameMenuOpen}
      onRename={() => setNameMenuOpen(true)}

        <View style={{ flexDirection: 'row', padding: 20 }}>
          <View style={{ flex: 1 }}>
            <ReportCardName
              name={meta?.name || t('Personal goal')}
              isEditing={nameMenuOpen}
              onChange={newName => {
                onMetaChange({
                  ...meta,
                  name: newName,
                });
                setNameMenuOpen(false);
              }}
              onClose={() => setNameMenuOpen(false)}
            />
          </View>
          <View style={{ textAlign: 'right' }}>
            <Block
              style={{
                ...styles.mediumText,
                fontWeight: 500,
                marginBottom: 5,
              }}
            >
              <PrivacyFilter activationFilters={[!isCardHovered]}>
                <FinancialText>{format(currentTotal, 'financial')}</FinancialText>
              </PrivacyFilter>
            </Block>
            <Block style={{ color: theme.pageTextSubdued }}>
              <PrivacyFilter activationFilters={[!isCardHovered]}>
                <Trans>
                  of{' '}
                  <FinancialText>
                    {{ target: format(targetAmount, 'financial') }}
                  </FinancialText>
                </Trans>
              </PrivacyFilter>
            </Block>
          </View>
        </View>

        <View
          style={{
            flex: 1,
            justifyContent: 'center',
            paddingLeft: 20,
            paddingRight: 20,
            paddingBottom: 20,
          }}
        >
          <View
            role="progressbar"
            aria-valuemin={0}
            aria-valuemax={100}
            aria-valuenow={Math.round(progress * 100)}
            style={{
              height: 12,
              borderRadius: 6,
              backgroundColor: theme.pillBackground,
              overflow: 'hidden',
            }}
          >
            <View
              style={{
                width: `${progress * 100}%`,
                height: '100%',
                backgroundColor: theme.reportsGreen,
              }}
            />
          </View>
          <Block
            style={{
              ...styles.tnum,
              marginTop: 5,
              textAlign: 'right',
              color: theme.pageTextSubdued,
            }}
          >
            {Math.round(progress * 100)}%
          </Block>
        </View>
      </View>
    </ReportCard>
  );
}

Yes. [GoalCard.tsx](packages/desktop-client/src/components/reports/reports/GoalCard.tsx) already has inline rename, built the same way as NetWorthCard and SummaryCard, so nothing needs to change.

1. Overview passes `isEditing` and `onMetaChange` into `GoalCard`, the same as for the other cards.
2. `GoalCard` gives `ReportCard` an `onRename` prop. Because that prop is set, `ReportCard` adds a "Rename" item to the card's menu ([ReportCard.tsx:159-162](packages/desktop-client/src/components/reports/ReportCard.tsx#L159-L162)).
3. Clicking "Rename" sets the local `nameMenuOpen` state to true. That state goes to `ReportCardName` as its `isEditing` prop, which turns the title into a text input.
4. When you confirm, `onChange` calls `onMetaChange({ ...meta, name: newName })`. Overview saves the new meta, keeping `targetAmount`, `currentAmount` and the other fields. Then the input closes.
5. While the input is open, `disableClick={nameMenuOpen}` keeps clicks from going through to the card.

Without a custom name, the title shows the default "Personal goal".

The card's `isEditing` prop means the dashboard is in layout edit mode, where cards can be dragged and resized. The rename input has its own state (`nameMenuOpen`). Other cards work the same way.

I haven't tried renaming in the running app. To test it, add a Personal goal card, open its menu, choose Rename, then reload the page to check that the new name was saved.

can I change my commit message after pushing it to the branch?

---

_**Agent (claude-opus-5-5 2026-10-01 21:21:49Z)**_

Yes, but changing a pushed commit rewrites history, so you'll need to force-push.

**For the most recent commit:**

```
git commit --amend -m "[AI] New message"
git push --force-with-lease
```

**For an older commit,** you'd normally use `git rebase -i HEAD~N` and mark the commit `reword`. That opens an interactive editor, which I can't run here, but it works fine in your own terminal.

Some things to know before you do it:

- **Use `--force-with-lease`, not `--force`.** It refuses to push if someone else has pushed to the branch since you last pulled, so you won't overwrite their work.
- **On a branch only you use, this is safe.** If teammates have pulled the branch, their copies will no longer match it, and they'll need to reset to the new history.
- **Open PRs update automatically.** GitHub shows the new commit, and the PR keeps working.
- **This repo requires `[AI]` at the start of commit messages for AI-assisted changes,** so keep it in the new message.

You haven't committed anything on `feat/issue-62-goal-card-scaffold` yet, so there's nothing to amend right now.

Closes #62

## What changed

Adds the first version of a **Personal goal** dashboard widget (`goal-card`). It sets up the type, the add widget menu entry and a display-only card, so the goal calculation can be built in a later PR.

- **Widget type**: `packages/loot-core/src/types/models/dashboard.ts`
  - Adds `GoalCardWidget`, built on `AbstractWidget` like `NetWorthWidget` and `SpendingWidget`. Its meta has `name`, `targetAmount`, `currentAmount`, `conditions`, `conditionsOp` and `timeFrame`. Amounts are integer cents, like every other amount in Actual.
  - Adds `GoalCardWidget` to the `SpecializedWidget` union.
- **Import validation**: `packages/loot-core/src/server/dashboard/app.ts`
  - Adds `'goal-card'` to `isWidgetType`, so dashboards that contain a goal card can be exported and imported again.
- **Add widget menu**: `packages/desktop-client/src/components/reports/Overview.tsx`
  - Adds a "Personal goal" entry. A new widget starts with `targetAmount: 0` and `currentAmount: 0`.
  - Shows `GoalCard` for widgets of type `goal-card`.
- **New card**: `packages/desktop-client/src/components/reports/reports/GoalCard.tsx`
  - Uses the same `ReportCard` and `ReportCardName` frame as `NetWorthCard` and `SummaryCard`. Inline rename works through `onRename`, and the new name is saved with `onMetaChange`.
  - Shows the current total, "of <target>", a progress bar and a percent label. Amounts use `FinancialText` and `PrivacyFilter`.
  - Progress is `currentAmount / targetAmount`, kept between 0% and 100%. A target of 0 shows 0%, so there's no divide-by-zero.

## Why

Issue #62 calls for a dashboard card that tracks progress toward a personal savings or spending goal. This PR only builds the structure: the data model, the menu entry and the UI. That way the next PR (calculating `currentAmount` from transactions that match `conditions` and `timeFrame`) only has to fill in real values, and the card doesn't need to change.

**Out of scope:** calculating real progress, editing the target amount in the UI, and a detail page you open by clicking the card.
